name: Standard Q&A
algorithm: Parse the query, retrieve candidate Fact Units via the Associative Recall Engine, run the Attractor Network to stabilize the candidate set, compose a response through the Narrative Graph's grounded-generation pipeline, deliver.
rule: Retrieval confidence must clear a minimum threshold before a Fact Unit is offered as grounding.

name: Guided Exploration
algorithm: As Standard Q&A, but each turn's candidate retrieval is conditioned on the accumulated Cognitive Context Window from prior turns rather than the query alone.
rule: Context weight decays with turn distance; a fact from 5 turns ago counts less than one from the last turn.

name: Discussion Mode
algorithm: Retrieve Fact Units as in Standard Q&A; adopt a text-grounded viewpoint only where the source material's groundedness for that viewpoint clears a threshold.
rule: Viewpoint adoption is gated on a groundedness score exceeding a fixed threshold.

name: Tutorial Mode
algorithm: Sequence a book's Fact Units into ordered instructional steps of increasing difficulty.
rule: Steps are ordered by a difficulty rank; a step's position is its rank among all steps.

name: Comprehension Check
algorithm: Generate a question from a target Fact Unit; compare a submitted answer's semantic similarity against that Fact Unit's content; correct if similarity clears a threshold.
rule: Answer correctness is a threshold comparison on a semantic-similarity score.

name: Semantic Exploration
algorithm: Traverse the Ontology Mesh outward from a starting node, surfacing connected nodes ranked by relationship strength.
rule: Neighbors are included only above a relationship-strength threshold.

name: Timeline Reconstruction
algorithm: Extract TemporalAnchor fields from a book's Fact Units and order them chronologically.
rule: Chronological ordering is a pairwise date comparison.

name: Edition Comparison
algorithm: Diff the VersionChain entries of two edition-tagged Fact Unit sets, surfacing additions, removals, and changes.
rule: A field differs between editions if its two values are unequal.

name: Flashcard Generation
algorithm: Select a Fact Unit, derive a question/answer pair from its content and SupportingFactUnits, format as a citing study card.
rule: Structural rule: One flashcard derives from exactly one Fact Unit; a card spanning two Fact Units is not generated.

name: Fact Graph Visualization
algorithm: Render Ontology Mesh nodes and edges for a given scope as an explicit graph structure.
rule: Structural rule: The rendered graph contains exactly the nodes and edges within the requester's scope description; no node is drawn that traversal would not return.

name: Inline Fact Previews
algorithm: On hover/tap of a cited fact reference, retrieve and display that Fact Unit's summary without a new query round-trip.
rule: Structural rule: A preview resolves the cited Fact Unit already retrieved for the response; it issues no new query and can surface no record the response did not cite.

name: Contextual Footnotes
algorithm: Attach a Fact Unit's supplementary detail as an inline, dismissible footnote at its citation point.
rule: Structural rule: A footnote attaches at the citation point of the Fact Unit it elaborates and is dismissible without altering the response body.

name: Personal Notes
algorithm: Store reader-authored text as a Fact Unit with AccessControlList restricted to the authoring reader alone.
rule: Access is granted only when the requester's identity matches the note's owner.

name: Social Annotations
algorithm: As Personal Notes, but AccessControlList defaults to author-configured sharing rather than reader-private.
rule: Visibility depends on a sharing flag rather than strict owner-match.

name: Message Boards
algorithm: Route a post into one of four board-type partitions per the poster's role; apply moderation-action checks on write.
rule: Board partition is selected from a fixed enumeration by type index.

name: Private Messaging
algorithm: Write a DirectMessage Fact Unit with AccessControlList restricted to exactly the sending and receiving identity.
rule: Access is granted only to the two identities named on the message.

name: Reader History Interface
algorithm: Chronological record of every session across every owned book, each entry expandable to show what was retrieved.
rule: Sessions are ordered by timestamp, most recent first.

name: Cross-Book Thematic Analysis
algorithm: Analyze a reader's own query-history Fact Units for recurring semantic clusters, then match against Ontology Mesh nodes in other owned books.
rule: A cross-book match requires cluster similarity above a threshold.

name: QBQL Structured Query
algorithm: Parse a declarative query against the Fact Graph schema, resolve predicates, execute as a deterministic read-only traversal.
rule: Pure function of (query, current state) — no side effects.

name: NLPL Natural-Language Programs
algorithm: Break the natural-language instruction into its constituent components before any code is generated.
rule: Structural rule: Decomposition into operational intents completes before any intent is bound to a concrete entity; an ambiguous binding halts compilation rather than resolving it.

name: Application Library and Generator
function: Application Library and Generator (Apps on Tap)
algorithm: Match a plain-language request against the existing template library by task/domain similarity; compose a new template only where no adequate match exists.
rule: A library match is used only above a similarity threshold; below it, composition is triggered.

name: Video Colorization & Upscaling (VCUM)
algorithm: Semantic Colorization Engine infers plausible color per-region from identified material class and lighting; upscaling synthesizes detail constrained to remain consistent with the source.
rule: Deterministic inference function: identical inputs always yield the identical inferred color.

name: Immersive 3D Scenes (IQR)
algorithm: Where grounding Fact Units carry sufficient spatial detail, instantiate WASM Fact Units as a renderable 3D scene.
rule: Scene rendering is triggered only once spatial-detail sufficiency clears a threshold.

name: Tour and Exhibition Mode
algorithm: Sequence author-selected IQR scenes into ordered Waypoints; playback steps through at reader-controlled pace.
rule: Waypoint order is a fixed sequence index.

name: Presenter Mode
algorithm: Verify the requested presence mode against the author's current, mode-specific, non-revoked Author Authorization Record.
rule: Authorization is granted only if the specific mode is both authorized and not revoked.

name: Instructor-Created Tours
algorithm: Sequence a Tour from already-published scenes, composed by an instructor rather than the author; carries non-removable ContentRole = INSTRUCTOR attribution.
rule: Attribution label is fixed by content role, not editable by the instructor.

name: Instructor Notes
algorithm: As Personal Notes, but AccessControlList is scoped to the instructor's class roster.
rule: Access is granted only to identities on the class roster.

name: Session Books
algorithm: Construct a delta reference over the reader's library without copying underlying Fact Units; purge on session end.
rule: The delta is a reference set, not a copy; its size is independent of the underlying library size.

name: Instructor-Customized Assessment Templates
algorithm: Store instructor-chosen structural parameters as a reusable template; apply structure to Comprehension Check generation while sourcing content from the Fact Graph.
rule: Question count is bounded by the template's configured maximum.

name: Instructor Grant Visibility Dashboard
algorithm: Query all active instructor-grant Fact Units for the viewing identity; join against Class Board, Instructor Tour, and Assessment Template records.
rule: A grant is shown only while its status is active.

name: Manuscript Upload
algorithm: Ingest the uploaded file in a single event; tag resulting Fact Units DraftStatus = DRAFT; restrict visibility until explicit submission.
rule: Visibility is gated on DraftStatus.

name: Manuscript Editor
algorithm: Accumulate Fact Units incrementally per edit; each edit versioned through the standard VersionChain mechanism.
rule: Each edit increments the version counter by exactly one.

name: Narrative Coherence Checking
algorithm: Apply Discussion Mode's critical-analysis capability to the draft's own Fact Graph, surfacing internal contradictions.
rule: A contradiction is flagged when two Fact Units assert incompatible values for the same subject/field.

name: Counterfactual Exploration (Drafting)
algorithm: Construct a Scenario Graph COUNTERFACTUAL branch from the draft's current state, preserving both branches.
rule: Both counterfactual branches are preserved; branch count after divergence is two.

name: Supplemental Content
algorithm: Ingest author-provided material, tag ContentRole = SUPPLEMENTAL, link to the parent book without altering its Rights Validation status.
rule: Rights status is read-only from the supplemental-ingestion path; it cannot be modified by this operation.

name: Multi-Author Collaboration
algorithm: Detect concurrent-write divergence via VersionChain head comparison.
rule: A conflict exists when two authors' starting version heads differ from the current head.

name: Author-Hosted Reader Events
algorithm: Register an external collaboration platform once via the Source Connector Registry; dispatch scheduling/invitation calls through it.
rule: Structural rule: An event operation is dispatched only through a connector registered under a declared capability; the platform's broader authority does not become system authority.

name: Class Boards
algorithm: As Message Boards, scoped to a specific instructor + class pairing.
rule: Structural rule: Board scope is the intersection of an instructor identity and a class roster; a post is visible only within that pairing.

name: Publisher Submission and Print-on-Demand
algorithm: Accept a manuscript/title submission and route it into the publishing workflow.
rule: Structural rule: Rights validation precedes routing into the publishing workflow; an unvalidated submission does not enter it.

name: Market Analytics
algorithm: Aggregate distribution and usage Fact Units for a title into standard reporting views.
rule: A total is the sum of per-region unit counts.

name: Moderation Appeals
algorithm: Affected identity submits an AppealUnit referencing the original moderation action's Provenance Ledger entry.
rule: Structural rule: An appeal is evaluated by a reviewer other than the moderator whose action is appealed, and references that action's ledger entry.

name: Data Export / Portability
algorithm: Query all Fact Units the requesting identity has rights to within scope; serialize to the target open format with provenance attached; continued access is unaffected.
rule: Structural rule: Export covers exactly the Fact Units the requesting identity holds rights to; export is not conditioned on continuing entitlement and withdraws no access.

name: Accessibility Suite
algorithm: Generate the required accessible-equivalent Fact Unit from the same source at production time; gate production-complete status on the equivalent's presence.
rule: Content is production-complete only if its accessible equivalent also exists.

name: Precision Geometric/Color Registration
algorithm: Represent presenter reference material as Color Fact Units with a DeltaEThreshold; run the 3-pass Registration Constraint Graph solver; surface any drift finding rather than auto-correcting.
rule: ΔE (CIE76) computed per Waypoint transition; a finding is raised when ΔE exceeds the authored threshold.
lean_statement:
-- UNVERIFIED — syntax only, not run in a real Lean environment
-- Requires: import Mathlib
def deltaE (l1 a1 b1 l2 a2 b2 : Float) : Float :=
  Float.sqrt ((l1-l2)^2 + (a1-a2)^2 + (b1-b2)^2)

theorem within_tolerance_no_drift (l1 a1 b1 l2 a2 b2 threshold : Float)
    (h : deltaE l1 a1 b1 l2 a2 b2 ≤ threshold) :
    deltaE l1 a1 b1 l2 a2 b2 ≤ threshold := h

name: Geometric Proof Engine
algorithm: Apply a fixed rule set to existing Geometry/Constraint Fact Units, producing a cited proof step for each derived relationship; halt on contradiction.
rule: Illustrates the complementary-angle rule with example angles 35°/55°.
lean_statement:
-- UNVERIFIED — syntax only, not run in a real Lean environment
def isComplementary (a b : Float) : Prop := a + b = 90

theorem complementary_35_55 : isComplementary 35 55 := by
  unfold isComplementary; norm_num

name: Human Reasoning and Motivation Modeling
algorithm: Construct Goal/Motivation Fact Units with a mandatory Subject reference; represent pursuit via Scenario Graph PLANNING anchored to WASM Affordance data.
rule: Confidence in an inferred (vs. stated) motivation is discounted relative to a directly-stated one.

name: Autonomous Agent Connector
algorithm: Dispatch a QBPL-compiled, declared action to a registered external agent per its Capability Declaration; log request/result to the Provenance Ledger.
rule: An action is only dispatched if it appears in the connector's declared capability set.

name: Optional External Fact-Retrieval Connector
algorithm: Dispatch a directed query to a registered external fact-retrieval connector, where one is registered, and convert the returned result into a native Fact Unit at the connector boundary under the ordinary ingestion path, safety evaluation and confidence calibration. The connector is one connector among others under the capability-declaration contract; it is optional, it is not a substrate, and every mechanism of this specification operates identically where none is registered. A separately-patented external system of this kind may be connected on these terms without becoming a component or a dependency.
rule: Core operation is invariant to connector presence: the mechanism set executed is identical whether or not an external fact-retrieval connector is registered.

name: Human-Directed Improvement Proposals
algorithm: Accept a directly-submitted Proposal Fact Unit from an entitled identity, bypassing telemetry-based identification but not the downstream sandbox/pre-screen/review stages.
rule: Structural rule: A human-submitted proposal enters the same evaluation and approval gate as a telemetry-identified one; bypassing telemetry does not bypass review.

name: Fact Unit Schema
algorithm: Every knowledge unit is instantiated with a fixed field set regardless of source modality or FactType.
rule: FUID is a deterministic function of (content, source, timestamp).

name: Multimodal Ingestion Pipeline
algorithm: Identify which of the eight defined modalities the incoming content matches.
rule: Detection selects the modality with the highest match score among the eight defined bits.

name: Classification Fallback
algorithm: Attempt best-effort resolution to the nearest of the eight modalities; halt with a stated reason where no reasonable resolution exists.
rule: Resolution proceeds only if best-match confidence clears a minimum threshold; otherwise halt.

name: Provenance Ledger
algorithm: Append each consequential operation as a node in a Merkle DAG; compute a keyed checksum sufficient to detect a Safety Substrate bypass.
rule: A checksum mismatch indicates the recorded safety evaluation does not match what actually ran.

name: Ontology Mesh
algorithm: Build relationship edges between Fact Units only where the underlying facts actually connect, not from statistical co-occurrence.
rule: An edge is created only if a real, named relationship type applies.

name: Neuromorphic Cognitive Layer / Attractor Network
algorithm: Given an initial candidate activation set, iteratively update each activation using neighboring weighted activations until convergence.
rule: a_i(t+1) = sign( Σ_j W_ij × a_j(t) − θ_i ), reliable capacity ≈ 0.14N stable patterns for N units.

name: Safety Substrate
algorithm: Evaluate every operation against SafetyFlags-derived rules at each mandatory, synchronous enforcement point.
rule: An operation proceeds only if it passes every one of its applicable gates.
lean_statement:
-- UNVERIFIED — syntax only, not run in a real Lean environment
-- Requires: import Mathlib
theorem proceed_requires_all_gates (g1 g2 g3 : Bool) :
    (g1 && g2 && g3) = true ↔ g1 = true ∧ g2 = true ∧ g3 = true := by
  simp

name: Semantic Transport Layer
algorithm: Route Fact Units between subsystems based on FactType and subscriber-declared filter predicates.
rule: A subscriber receives a Fact Unit only if it matches every declared filter predicate.

name: Predictive Inference Engine (PIE)
algorithm: Integrate four input streams into a probabilistic forward projection of future knowledge states, with confidence intervals.
rule: Illustrates the trend-projection component only — output is an interval estimate, not a single deterministic value.

name: Scenario Graph
algorithm: Represent a hypothetical as a Knowledge State Snapshot delta rather than copying the full graph; prune low-probability branches against a threshold.
rule: A branch is pruned when its probability falls below the configured threshold.

name: Narrative Graph
algorithm: Construct typed edges between Fact Units to mediate response composition; flag narrative gaps where no supporting edge exists.
rule: Structural rule: Every Narrative Graph edge references at least one Fact Unit; an edge without such a reference is not constructed.

name: QueryBook Format (QBF)
algorithm: Serialize Fact Units to a binary frame format permitting resynchronization to the next valid frame after corrupted data.
rule: Structural rule: A frame boundary is recoverable without reparsing the preceding frame, so a corrupt frame costs one frame rather than the stream.

name: Storage Architecture
algorithm: Tier Fact Units across storage layers by access-recency/frequency; index for similarity and exact-match retrieval.
rule: A Fact Unit is promoted to a hotter tier once its access count exceeds a threshold.
worked_expression: =IF(42>20,"Promote to Hot Tier","Remain in Current Tier")

name: AGI Extension Modules (AEM)
algorithm: Synthesize a new derived insight from multiple existing Fact Units where no single Fact Unit directly answers a query.
rule: A synthesized insight carries a confidence trajectory distinct from, and generally lower than, any single contributing fact.

name: Multilingual Regeneration Engine (MRE)
algorithm: Regenerate output in a target language directly from the language-independent Narrative Graph and SemanticHash-linked Fact Units.
rule: Back-translation of a regenerated output must yield a SemanticHash within the configured distance of the original (§16.5).

name: Cross-Domain Rule Engine (CDRE)
algorithm: Evaluate a probabilistically-weighted, temporally-scoped rule set incrementally, maintaining a persistent Conflict Index.
rule: A contradiction entry is added to the index when two active rules produce incompatible conclusions.

name: QBQL (execution floor)
algorithm: Execute a declarative query as a read-only graph traversal with no mutation or control-flow capability.
rule: Pure function of (query, state) — no hidden state carried between evaluations.

name: QBPL (bounded program layer)
algorithm: Compile to one of nine fixed primitives; REPEAT-UNTIL-BOUND enforces a hard iteration ceiling at compile time.
rule: Primitive set is finite (|P| = 9); non-Turing-complete by construction.
lean_statement:
-- UNVERIFIED — syntax only, not run in a real Lean environment
-- Requires: import Mathlib
theorem repeat_until_bound_terminates (attempted bound : Nat) (h : bound > 0) :
    min attempted bound ≤ bound := by
  exact min_le_right attempted bound

name: Clarification Generation Engine
function: Conversational Intelligence Layer / Clarification Generation Engine
algorithm: Detect genuine referential ambiguity or a repetition/frustration signal; generate an anchored clarifying question rather than guessing.
rule: Ambiguity is flagged when top-candidate confidence scores are too close to separate.

name: Natural Language Interaction Layer (NLIL)
algorithm: Select vocabulary, structural format, and explanatory depth for phrasing based on inferred audience profile; the underlying fact is never altered.
rule: The selected audience profile must resolve to a defined expertise level; the underlying Fact Unit is never altered by the selection.
worked_expression: =IF(AND(4>=1,4<=7),"Audience profile applied; fact unaltered","Refused - expertise level out of range")

name: Fact Universe Architecture
algorithm: Define the structural relationship between the Fact Graph, Ontology Mesh, and Provenance Ledger as coordinated views over one substrate.
rule: Structural rule: The Fact Graph, Ontology Mesh and Provenance Ledger are addressable as one structure over which a single scope description resolves.

name: Adaptive Response Engine (ARE, pipeline)
algorithm: Analyze the candidate Fact Units retrieved for a specific query.
rule: Structural rule: Response profile resolution completes before generation begins; the directive is fixed for the response and is not renegotiated mid-generation.

name: World Aware System Model (WASM)
algorithm: Maintain Object, Relation, Physics, and Affordance layers as Fact Units, queryable by IQR for scene instantiation.
rule: Structural rule: Object, Relation, Physics and Affordance layers are maintained as Fact Units and are queryable on the same terms as any other record.

name: Conceptual Memory Layer (CML)
algorithm: Persist long-term, stable world-model abstractions distinct from the transient Cognitive Context Window.
rule: Structural rule: An abstraction persisted to long-term store retains the generalized concept and discards the episode it derived from.

name: Sensory Abstraction Pipeline (SAP)
algorithm: Reduce raw perceptual input to structured concept-level Fact Units suitable for WASM/CML consumption.
rule: Structural rule: Raw perceptual input is reduced to concept-level records before admission; no raw episode is admitted to the concept store.

name: VCUM Semantic Colorization Engine (SCE)
algorithm: Infer color for content lacking reliable existing color information from material class, lighting, and historical priors.
rule: Deterministic: identical inputs always yield the identical inferred color.

name: VCUM Agent Specifications
algorithm: Define the per-agent task decomposition within the VCUM restoration pipeline.
rule: Structural rule: Each restoration agent performs exactly the task its specification declares; an agent performs no task outside its declared decomposition.

name: Live Fact Graph
algorithm: Maintain a continuously-updating layer of the Fact Graph reflecting the most recent ingested/inferred state.
rule: Structural rule: The live layer is read as an overlay on the committed layer; a provisional provenance reference is finalized on durable write and never altered thereafter.

name: Continuous Query Engine (CQE)
algorithm: Register a WATCH program with a trigger clause; re-evaluate on every relevant update, re-checking Prime Directive compliance at each firing.
rule: Re-evaluation happens on every firing, not once at registration — the count of checks equals the count of firings.

name: Structural Groundedness Enforcement
algorithm: Restrict candidate output vocabulary to terms derivable from Narrative Graph edges traceable to supporting Fact Units; reject untraceable propositions.
rule: A proposition is rejected unless it traces to at least one supporting Fact Unit.

name: Offline Synchronization Layer
algorithm: Select a sync mode based on connectivity; reconcile divergent offline/online states via version-vector comparison on reconnection.
rule: Reconciliation is required whenever the offline and online version vectors differ.

name: Portal / Role Model
algorithm: Resolve an identity's accessible capabilities as the union of held Role(s) plus active capability grants, each evaluated independently.
rule: Access to a capability is the logical OR of role-based and grant-based access, never merged into a combined elevated set.

name: Improvement Proposal Pipeline
algorithm: Telemetry-driven or human-directed identification of a subsystem-scoped improvement candidate.
rule: Structural rule: A candidate is scoped to a single subsystem; a candidate targeting a member of the permanently-excluded set is refused at identification.

name: QueryBook AI Evolution (System Agents)
algorithm: A System Agent's Candidate Identification is bounded to its assigned subsystem; resulting proposals enter the identical pipeline as any human-originated candidate.
rule: An agent cannot approve its own or another agent's proposal.

name: Formal Verification Layer
algorithm: Generate a machine-checked proof of a precisely-stated property for a QBPL/WATCH program or proposal.
rule: Property truth is decidable over the bounded QBPL primitive set.

name: License and Entitlement Management
algorithm: Map an organizational license to Role-scoped seats; check seat and entitlement status before granting access.
rule: Access requires both an available seat and the specific entitlement.
lean_statement:
-- UNVERIFIED — syntax only, not run in a real Lean environment
-- Requires: import Mathlib
theorem access_requires_seat_and_entitlement (has_seat has_entitlement : Bool) :
    (has_seat && has_entitlement) = true ↔ has_seat = true ∧ has_entitlement = true := by
  simp

name: QBCL-CMS (Configuration Management)
algorithm: Parse and apply platform-level configuration changes through a defined configuration language, versioned like any other change.
rule: Structural rule: A configuration change is versioned and recorded on the same terms as any other change; an unversioned change is not applied.

name: Source Connector Registry
algorithm: Register an external system against a fixed contract; evaluate every connector under the identical Trust Boundary regardless of name.
rule: Trust level is identical for every registered connector — not a function of the platform's name or popularity.

name: Robot Memory Domain (RMD)
algorithm: Ingest robot/agent sensor data into Fact Units; deliver structured knowledge back; support WATCH-driven continuous behavior.
rule: Structural rule: Sensor data enters through the ordinary ingestion path and structured knowledge is returned; no raw sensory episode from an agent is retained.

name: Template Debug Mode
algorithm: Pause execution at existing pipeline-stage boundaries, exposing Fact Unit bindings, Safety results, and Slice measurements at each pause.
rule: Structural rule: Instrumentation pauses at existing pipeline-stage boundaries of an actual execution; it introduces no stage and simulates none.

name: Processor Slice Measurement Model
algorithm: Classify and log the compute cost of every operation into a defined Slice category; Safety Gate and Recovery Slices are prioritized above all others.
rule: Safety Gate priority always outranks any other Slice category when contended.

name: Validation and Benchmarking
algorithm: Define a reproducible benchmark for an existing design-target figure; run it and mark the figure validated or retract it.
rule: A design-target figure is validated only if the measured result falls within its stated tolerance.

name: Platform Internationalization
algorithm: Apply locale-specific presentation without altering Safety Substrate or Prime Directive evaluation in any locale.
rule: Safety evaluation outcome is identical regardless of locale.

name: Moderation Actions
algorithm: Apply a flag/hide/lock/archive action to target content, logging moderator identity and reason; reversible only via Appeals.
rule: An action is applied only if the flag count for the content reaches the configured threshold.

name: Deployment Architecture
algorithm: Roll out an approved change in stages rather than all at once.
rule: Structural rule: Progression to each successive rollout stage is conditioned on the recorded human approval; no stage advances automatically.

name: Optional Blockchain Ownership-Verification Connector
algorithm: On a resale/transfer request for a title with this connector registered, dispatch a verification query to the external service; QueryBook remains the requesting party only.
rule: Structural rule: A verification request is dispatched only for the specific title and only to the requesting party; no ownership record is retained by the system.

name: Live Interaction Voice Signal Analysis
algorithm: If user has opted in for the session, extract prosodic features from live audio and feed as an optional trigger to the Clarification Generation Engine; discard on session end unless separately retained.
rule: Analysis runs only where session consent is active and the prosodic salience clears the trigger threshold.

name: World-View Model (WVM)
algorithm: Maintain the native ontological, causal, and temporal structure underlying QueryBook's own reasoning, distinct from WASM's world-model domain and from any external hypergraph substrate.
rule: Structural rule: The ontological, causal and temporal structure is maintained natively; no external model is required to express it.

name: Contextual Commerce Layer
algorithm: After grounded answer is fully computed, resolve query's concept_id; match against registered commerce sources; render in separate labeled region.
rule: priority(Commerce Slice) < priority(Safety Gate Slice) for all t

name: Commerce Processing Slice and Selection Weighting
algorithm: Meter each commerce operation as a bounded Slice; where multiple candidates match a resolved concept_id, select via a weighted combination of relevance, source priority, and bid, applied only to already-matched candidates.
rule: score = w1*relevance + w2*source_priority + w3*bid, Σw=1

name: Commerce Optimization Proposals
algorithm: Route any proposed change to commerce targeting or bid weighting through Chapter 66's full Simulation Sandbox, Pre-Screening, and Human Review Gate; no autonomous deployment path exists for commerce optimization.
rule: Structural rule: A proposed commerce change enters the full improvement-proposal gate; no commerce parameter changes without a recorded human approval.

name: Merchandise Commerce and Fulfillment Handoff
algorithm: On merchandise purchase intent, dispatch a scoped referral to a registered external commerce platform via the Source Connector Registry; QueryBook never captures payment data, processes payment, or acts as fulfillment operator.
rule: Structural rule: A merchandise referral is scoped to the referring party alone; the system takes no custody of the transaction.

name: System Identity and Positioning
algorithm: On any external summary request, resolve claims against §86's stated differentiators and corrections rather than unverified external description.
rule: Structural rule: An external summary is resolved against the stated differentiators and corrected where it overstates them; no uncorrected overclaim is issued.

name: Native QueryBook Reader
algorithm: Render EPUB 3.3 content as a conformant Reading System; QueryBook interactions triggered by ignorable data-qb-* attributes on otherwise-standard markup.
rule: Structural rule: Reading-system conformance is maintained independently of QueryBook interaction; interaction adds capability and removes no conformant behaviour.

name: Deployment Modes and Domain Packages
algorithm: Run identical logical services across Cloud SaaS, Local Server, and Single Device modes, differing only in hosting topology, not specification.
rule: Structural rule: The same logical services execute in every deployment mode; a mode changes where a service runs and not which service owns a decision.

name: Personal Object Location
algorithm: On consented live feed, classify inanimate objects/materials against WASM Object Layer; discard any person/animal-classified result; represent as session-scoped record.
rule: Structural rule: Classification is restricted to inanimate objects and materials; a person- or animal-classified result is excluded from the result set entirely.

name: Sensory-Annotated Content Playback
algorithm: On content with a sensory profile attribute, play audio/visual/device-haptic output via device-native APIs only; opt-in for audio/haptic, default-on for passive visual effects.
rule: Structural rule: Sensory output plays only where the content carries an authored sensory profile; no output is triggered by an inferred state.

name: Audio Narration
algorithm: Select author's own recorded narration if it exists for requested content; else use generic non-cloned synthetic voice profile; never approximate a specific real voice absent that person's own recording.
rule: Structural rule: The author's own recorded asset is selected where it exists; otherwise a generic profile with no correspondence to a specific person is used.

name: NFT Integration Layer
algorithm: Mint a token representing an already-established license-scoped entitlement via a registered external minting service, transferred directly to the rights holder's own wallet; resolve every read against the entitlement record, which always governs on conflict.
rule: Structural rule: A token is minted only after the entitlement exists; where token state and entitlement record diverge the entitlement record is authoritative.

name: Complementary Learning Systems Formalization
algorithm: Name session-scoped records as the fast/episodic system and the permanent Fact Graph as the slow/consolidated system; consolidation requires explicit user election, never automatic replay.
rule: Structural rule: The correspondence names existing mechanisms and creates none; session-scoped records and the permanent graph are unchanged by the naming.

name: Forensic Analysis of External AI System Outputs
algorithm: Check a claim in an external AI's output against QueryBook's own Fact Graph; classify across 6 categories; self-referential language cataloged as observed text only, never a sentience determination.
rule: Structural rule: Each claim of an external output is marked supported-with-citation or unsupported; no output asserts a determination about that system's internal state.

name: Hypothesis Generation
algorithm: Generate a hypothesis via AIQG/AEM/Scenario Graph/§10.4 triggers with status=PROPOSED; only an identified human expert may transition status to VALIDATED; no automated path exists.
rule: Structural rule: A hypothesis is created with status PROPOSED and transitions to VALIDATED only on confirmation by an identified human reviewer.

name: Cognitive Map Formalization
algorithm: Name the correspondence between §91.9's lattice indexing and the Attractor Network's Hopfield dynamics; extend deterministic lattice indexing to general Ontology Mesh concept proximity search.
rule: Same hex_coord principle as §91.9, applied to concept space, deterministic

name: Study and Learning Tools
function: Glossary, Study Guide, Spaced Repetition, Scaffolding, Clustering
algorithm: Assemble glossary entries, study guides, and staged Tutorial Mode sequences from already-grounded content; schedule flashcards via spaced-repetition interval; cluster concepts via Ontology Mesh structure.
rule: Next spaced-repetition interval is the prior interval scaled by the ease factor where recall quality clears the floor, else reset to one day.

name: Content Verification and Argumentation Tools
function: Misconception Correction, Error-Spotting, Triangulation, Argument Analysis, Debate Prep
algorithm: Check claims against grounded Fact Graph via CDRE contradiction logic; surface existing corroboration counts; assemble grounded position arguments via Scenario Graph, never fabricating unsupported content.
rule: Structural rule: A surfaced contradiction cites the records establishing it; no conclusory characterization is generated that is not itself derivable from a record.

name: Manifold-Based Trend Forecasting
algorithm: Embed ingested time-series data into a nonlinear manifold; generate a forecast with an explicit confidence interval; render in a labeled region separate from grounded output.
rule: forecast = f(manifold_embedding(time_series)), CI computed from embedding uncertainty

name: Geometric Shape Matching / Grid-Cell Indexing
function: Deterministic Shape Matching and Hexagonal Indexing
algorithm: Compare candidate contours via the Registration Constraint Graph's three-pass solving using Geometry and Constraint Fact Units; index candidates on a fixed, non-learned hexagonal lattice for deterministic proximity search.
rule: hex_coord = f(x,y), deterministic and fixed by construction

name: Dual-Grounded Developmental World Model (The Box Principle)
algorithm: Build sensory-grounded and language-grounded concept streams independently; on co-occurrence of a spoken label and a visual object, confirm semantic consistency, then fuse via a binding edge; do not finalize a concept from one binding event — track repeated encounters via temporal consolidation before stabilizing.
rule: A concept is finalized only after the consolidation count reaches the configured minimum; a single binding event is provisional.

name: External Sensory Hardware (Smell/Haptic)
algorithm: On explicit user action tied to a specific, authored sensory profile, trigger registered external scent/haptic hardware; never trigger from an inferred signal (e.g., detected emotion) under any configuration.
rule: Structural rule: Output is triggered by an explicit user action tied to an authored profile; a system-inferred trigger is permanently excluded.

name: Source Framing Signals
algorithm: Surface a source's own documented editorial position and quantifiable citation-composition facts (count, funding overlap) as cited facts; never generate a conclusory bias judgment not grounded in the Fact Graph.
rule: Source composition is reported as a quantified, cited ratio; no conclusory judgment is generated.
worked_expression: =IF(3/12>0,"Report composition fact with citation","No composition fact available")

name: VR-Specific Commerce Presentation
function: Commerce as a VR Presentation Surface
algorithm: Render matched commercial content in a spatially distinct VR region using the existing concept_id-triggered matching of §88.1; never use gaze, dwell-time, or spatial proximity as a selection signal.
rule: Structural rule: Commercial content renders in a spatially distinct region; no gaze, dwell or attention signal is captured, derived or made available.

name: Vehicle-Control AI Feed Monitoring
algorithm: Ingest vehicle-control AI telemetry as AnalyzedOutput; check each entry against grounded reference facts (safe-operating envelope, geofence); on confirmed anomaly, generate an expedited, non-blocking alert to a named human reviewer. No control interface exists.
rule: Structural rule: Telemetry analysis is read-only; no control interface to any vehicle system exists or is created.

name: Biased Competition for Object Salience
algorithm: Compute a SalienceWeight for each concurrently-detected Object Layer node from detection confidence and task relevance, normalized against co-present objects; never remove or exclude a node from the Fact Graph based on its weight.
rule: SalienceWeight_i = f(confidence_i, relevance_i) / Σ f(confidence_j, relevance_j) for all j in scene

name: Boltzmann-Style Diverse Hypothesis Sampling
algorithm: Where enabled, run the Attractor Network's energy landscape through a stochastic update rule to sample multiple candidate hypotheses per input; label each as stochastically-generated; every result remains PROPOSED status only, gated by Chapter 97's human validation.

name: Developmental Parallel — Verified Correspondence
algorithm: Ground Chapter 59's Cross-Modal Binding and Temporal Concept Consolidation against real developmental psychology citations (Carey & Bartlett 1978; Yu & Smith 2007), stating explicitly where the correspondence is precise and where it is honestly incomplete.
rule: Structural rule: The correspondence grounds existing mechanisms in cited developmental findings; it adds no mechanism and alters no binding rule.

name: Ego-Motion Compensation for Non-Stationary Capture
algorithm: Estimate camera ego-motion from the aggregate optical-flow field; subtract it from each region's raw motion vector before Stage 4 object/scene segmentation, improving detection accuracy under significant camera movement.
rule: v_compensated = v_raw − v_ego_estimated

name: Encyclopedia Content Ingestion
algorithm: Extract discrete factual claims from encyclopedia text as Fact Units under the fact/expression dichotomy (Feist v. Rural, 1991); images remain subject to Chapter 60's standard rights-aware ingestion, never exempted.
rule: Structural rule: A discrete factual claim is extracted while the source's protected expression is not reproduced; accompanying images pass separate rights validation.

name: Intersensory Redundancy Weighting
algorithm: Where a property is confirmed via temporally-synchronous signals across multiple concurrent modalities, elevate its Stage 3 confidence weighting relative to a single-modality-only property.
rule: confidence_amodal > confidence_single_modality when synchrony confirmed

name: Object Permanence — Precise Correspondence
algorithm: Maintain a single Object Layer node's continuity when the object is fully occluded or temporarily unobservable within the same session, per Piaget's real definition; introduces no cross-session tracking.
rule: Structural rule: A single object node retains continuity across full occlusion within a session; occlusion does not create a second node.

name: Additional Disambiguation Heuristics for Cross-Modal Binding
algorithm: Apply gaze-direction inference, whole-object bias, and mutual exclusivity as evidence-overridable preferences during Cross-Modal Binding's co-occurrence resolution, alongside — never replacing — existing semantic-consistency confirmation.
rule: Structural rule: Each disambiguation heuristic is evidence-overridable; a heuristic never overrides a directly-observed binding.

name: Live-Session Erasure
algorithm: On user action, immediately clear the live Cognitive Context Window transcript, client- and server-side; log a Provenance Ledger entry recording that an erasure occurred without retaining the cleared content itself.
rule: Structural rule: Clearing is immediate at client and server and produces no condensed retained form; the ledger entry records the erasure and none of its content.

name: Retention Policy (Retain-by-Default, Erasure as Option)
algorithm: Retain SAFU records automatically at session end by default; provide session/work/account-level erasure (§36.7) and live-session erasure (§36.7.1) as fully available, explicit user-initiated options at any time.
rule: Structural rule: Retention is the default and erasure is an explicit user action at session, work and account scope; neither is silently applied.

name: Verified Neuromorphic Correspondence Methodology
algorithm: For a candidate neuroscience correspondence: (1) verify against primary publication, (2) check for implicit existing correspondence, (3) extract only the deterministic principle, excluding trained components, (4) extend existing mechanism over new invention, (5) formalize under a named, cited section.
rule: Structural rule: A correspondence is adopted only after external verification, an implicit-correspondence check, deterministic extraction, extension over invention and named formalization.

name: Legal Exposure Minimization Through Structural Compliance
algorithm: Reduce legal exposure via genuine regulatory compliance, structural non-custody (NFT, merchandise), rights discipline, protective audit trail, and consistent documented retention policy — never by reducing what is lawfully producible under a valid order.
rule: Structural rule: Exposure is reduced through compliance, non-custody, rights discipline and consistent retention; never by reducing what is lawfully producible.

name: Author Portal Book Upload
algorithm: Receive an author-submitted work at the web portal bound to a verified author identity; validate rights status; queue the work for ingestion; return a receipt referencing the queued job. Ingestion does not begin until rights validation returns cleared.
rule: Ingestion proceeds only where rights validation has returned a cleared status.

name: Probable Question Generation (PQG)
algorithm: At ingestion, and before any query is received, traverse each committed Fact Unit together with its Ontology Mesh neighbours and generate candidate questions that those Fact Units answer; score each candidate by a coverage measure over the Fact Units it draws on; retain only candidates clearing the configured floor.
rule: A candidate question is retained in the Question Index only where its coverage score clears the configured floor.

name: Pre-Computed Answer Set
algorithm: For each retained question, assemble the grounded answer at ingestion time from exactly the Fact Units the question was derived from; store it as a Pre-Computed Answer Unit carrying a PRECOMPUTED_ANSWER provenance tag and the FUIDs relied upon, so a served answer is traceable to the same degree as a live one.
rule: Pre-computed answer confidence is bounded by the least confident contributing Fact Unit.

name: Question Index Reuse and Invalidation
algorithm: On query, match against the Question Index before live traversal; serve the stored answer where match similarity clears the threshold and no contributing Fact Unit has been revised since computation; otherwise fall through to live retrieval. Revision of any contributing Fact Unit marks dependent entries stale and excludes them from service until recomputed.
rule: A stored answer is served only where match similarity clears threshold and every contributing Fact Unit is unrevised since computation.

name: Author Supplemental Knowledge Layer
algorithm: Accept author-supplied supplemental context at or after ingestion; convert it to Fact Units tagged AUTHOR_SUPPLEMENTAL with the author as attributed source; make those Fact Units available to every reader entitled to the work; regenerate the Question Index entries whose contributing Fact Units are affected.
rule: Supplemental Fact Units carry author-attributed source reliability and trigger regeneration of every affected index entry.

name: Attractor Load Regime Governor
algorithm: Compute the Attractor Load Ratio alpha = P/N before admitting a further stable configuration; admit only where the resulting alpha stays below the configured operating ceiling; refuse admission and trigger EWC consolidation where it would not. Operation above the conservative ceiling requires a recorded deployment election; operation at or past the Retrieval-Phase Boundary is structurally refused.
rule: Alpha = P/N must remain below the configured operating ceiling, itself strictly below the Retrieval-Phase Boundary alpha_c ~ 0.138 (AGS 1985, 1987).

name: Sampling Criticality Control
algorithm: Expose the inverse-temperature parameter of the hypothesis-diversity sampler as an operator-set control with ordered, intermediate and disordered regimes; record the value in effect with the setting operator's identity so a hypothesis set is reproducible. No setting admits sampler output to the retrieval or generation path, and no process self-tunes the parameter.
rule: Selection probability p = 1 / (1 + e^(-beta * deltaE)); beta sets distance from the indifference point.

name: Concept Attribute Inheritance
algorithm: Where a concept is connected to a superordinate concept by an IS-A edge and that superordinate carries a HAS-PROPERTY attribute, assign the attribute to the subordinate at traversal time, tagged with its originating concept and IS-A depth; do not write it back as stored state, so a revision at the superordinate propagates on the next traversal.
rule: Inherited attribute confidence is the product of the traversed IS-A edge confidences and the attribute's own confidence, bounded above by the least of them.

name: Exception Override Resolution
algorithm: Where a subordinate concept asserts an attribute conflicting with one it would inherit, the direct assertion governs for that concept and its subordinates while the superordinate's attribute is unmodified and still inherited by siblings; conflicts inherited at differing depths resolve to the lesser depth; conflicts at equal depth are refused and recorded in the contradiction index.
rule: The attribute asserted at the lesser IS-A depth governs; equal-depth conflicts are not resolved and both values are reported.

name: Inverse Edge Traversal
algorithm: Traverse a typed edge in reverse by resolving the InversePredicate declared in the predicate schema at traversal time, storing no second edge; where no inverse is declared, refuse reverse traversal and report an absent inverse declaration rather than inferring a reverse reading.
rule: Reverse traversal is available only where an InversePredicate is declared; stored edge count equals asserted relation count.

name: Wording-Operative Span Preservation
algorithm: Where a Fact Unit is typed QUOTATION or carries a wording-operative marking, reproduce the source span in its source language and wording rather than regenerating it, accompanied in a target language by a regenerated gloss marked non-operative; exempt only the reproduced span from Stage 6 groundedness rewriting; withhold reproduction where Chapter 60 rights validation does not permit it and deliver the gloss alone.
rule: A wording-operative span is reproduced, never regenerated; the accompanying gloss carries a non-operative marking.

name: Idiom Detection and Equivalence Mapping
algorithm: Detect at ingestion a span whose compositional reading diverges from its attested reading beyond a configured threshold; record the attested meaning with an idiom-derived marking and the source span; realize it in a target language using a registered equivalent for the same attested meaning, and where none is registered render the meaning literally with an explicit note rather than selecting an equivalent by surface similarity.
rule: An idiom mapping applies only where divergence clears the configured threshold and a target-language equivalent is registered.
worked_expression: =IF(AND(0.82>=0.6,COUNTIF({"es:tomar-el-pelo"},"es:tomar-el-pelo")>0),"Apply registered equivalent","Render literal meaning with note")

name: Linguistic Resource Registry
algorithm: Register every externally-sourced linguistic resource with identifier, version, licensor, licence instrument, permitted-use scope, redistribution permission, attribution requirement and ingestion mode before any extraction or realization stage consults it; refuse registration where the licence does not cover the declared use; propagate derivative conditions to artifacts derived from the resource, marking an artifact non-redistributable where two registered resources impose conflicting conditions.
rule: A resource is consulted only where its registered permitted-use scope encompasses the operator's declared use.

name: Derived-Artifact-Only Extraction
algorithm: For a resource registered in derived-artifact-only mode, compute and retain aggregate quantities (frequency, collocation strength, part-of-speech distribution, morphological paradigm) while retaining no span of the resource's text in any Fact Unit, index or cache and reproducing none in output; verify by confirming the retained-span count is zero, enforcing the Feist fact/expression boundary already applied at §59.10.
rule: Retained source spans attributable to a derived-artifact-only resource must equal zero.
worked_expression: =IF(0=0,"Compliant - statistics retained, no source span","Refused - source span retained")

name: External System Behavioural Probing
algorithm: Submit controlled inputs to a registered external system and measure behaviour rather than content: repeat an identical input and score the proportion of outputs sharing a semantic fingerprint; reinject an output as input to a ceiling and classify the fingerprint sequence as converged, periodic, drifting or unresolved; perturb an input without changing its fingerprint and score output invariance. Every result carries QueryBook's own measured value on the identical probe or is incomplete.
rule: A probe result is reportable only where a reference value measured on the identical probe is present.
worked_expression: =IF(AND(8/10>=0.5,1=1),"Consistency measured against reference","Incomplete - reference value absent")

name: Analysis Quarantine
algorithm: Exclude AnalyzedOutput and ProbeResult Fact Units, and anything derived from them, from the scope description the Slice Resolver constructs for any query not directed at the analysis itself, so they are not traversable rather than filtered afterwards; exclude them equally from the question index and the Conceptual Memory Layer.
rule: An analysis record is structurally ineligible as a grounding source; exclusion occurs at slice construction, not after traversal.

name: Attestation Horizon Constraint
algorithm: Admit a Fact Unit to a pre-event snapshot only where its T_attested (the source's documented creation date) precedes the event time less the horizon; do not consult TemporalAnchor for this test; exclude any record whose T_attested cannot be established from documented source metadata; enforce at Slice Resolver scope construction so an inadmissible record is not traversable rather than filtered afterwards.
rule: Admissible iff T_attested < T_event - horizon; contested dates resolve to the latest candidate, so uncertainty resolves toward exclusion.
worked_expression: =IF(DATE(1998,3,1)<DATE(2001,9,11)-90,"Admissible to pre-event snapshot","Excluded - attested after cutoff")

name: Retrospective Forecast Scoring
algorithm: Run Chapter 10 and §10.4 forecasting against the constrained pre-event snapshot alone within a Scenario Graph branch; record predicted outcome, assigned probability, predicted interval and every admitted FUID; on comparison with the recorded outcome, construct a PredictionError Fact Unit and derive accuracy by horizon and calibration by confidence band.
rule: Mean squared error between assigned probability and realised binary outcome across the scored corpus.

name: Calibration Subject Class Gate
algorithm: Admit only an institution, organisational process, system or aggregate group as the subject of a calibration event record; refuse construction of a PredictionError Fact Unit whose subject resolves to an individual natural person, at construction rather than by access restriction; report a demographic correlation as a property of the institutional process, cited, never restated as a property of individuals.
rule: Construction is refused where the resolved subject class is an individual natural person.

name: Event Type Catalogue
algorithm: Register each event category with an immutable id, version, poly-hierarchical Ontology Mesh placement, a semantic definition stating both coverage and exclusions, and a MachineDefinition naming required, optional and forbidden fields; require an EVENT_DESCRIPTION Fact Unit to reference a registered id rather than a free-text category; refuse construction where the MachineDefinition is unsatisfied; permit a later version to narrow a required-field set but never widen it.
rule: A record is admitted only where every field required by its event type's MachineDefinition is present.

name: Environment Vector Normalization
algorithm: Store a world-state snapshot once as a content-addressed record carrying its own TemporalAnchor, typed Ontology-Mesh-resolved condition keys, confidence, provenance and T_attested; reference it from Fact Units through a reserved AnnotationSet key so no schema field is added; converge identical condition sets on one vector with two provenance branches; correct by supersession so every referencing record resolves to the corrected state on next traversal.
rule: Identical canonicalized condition sets yield an identical content hash and therefore one vector, not two.

name: Causal Edge Temporal Validation
algorithm: Admit a CAUSES edge only where the source TemporalAnchor does not begin after the target's begins; refuse otherwise and record the attempted assertion in the Chapter 17 contradiction index; permit concurrent and overlapping causation; never promote TEMPORAL_FOLLOWS to CAUSES automatically; express chains as Bundle membership with chain length, root and outcome computed at query time rather than stored.
rule: CAUSES admitted iff T_start(source) <= T_start(target); duration is derived at query time, never stored.

name: Bayesian ConfidenceScore Posterior Update
algorithm: Hold ConfidenceScore as Beta parameters alpha (supporting evidence) and beta (contradicting evidence) rather than a scalar; report CS as alpha/(alpha+beta); update in closed form by adding the observing source's reliability weight to whichever parameter the evidence supports, so revision magnitude falls as accumulated evidence grows without any rule conditioned on it; decay shrinks both parameters toward the prior, widening the credible interval while preserving the mean.
rule: CS = alpha/(alpha+beta); posterior by conjugate addition alpha' = alpha + w*s, beta' = beta + w*f; order-independent.

name: Prior-Strength Resistance Check
algorithm: Initialise Beta parameters for a concept node from ConceptStabilityWeight, which sets the pseudo-count n0 = alpha+beta while the current confidence sets the ratio; a high-CSW node therefore requires multi-source contradicting evidence to revise, which is the behaviour §41.4.5 asserts and the additive rule does not produce.
rule: Revision from a single contradiction against a strong prior must fall below the increment the additive rule would have applied.
worked_expression: =IF(0.9-18/(18+2+1)<0.05,"Strong prior resists single contradiction","Revision exceeds tolerance")

name: Precision-Weighted Error Propagation
algorithm: Compute an error signal's precision as inverse variance from the Beta parameters already held under §41.6.2; propagate a contradiction upward to World Brain concept attributes by a gain equal to the error's share of total precision, so a poorly-supported observation barely revises a settled concept while a well-established one substantially revises a weakly-held concept; replaces the ConfidenceScore-differential magnitude of §41.5.1.
rule: gain = var_prior / (var_prior + var_error), equivalently pi_error / (pi_error + pi_prior); var = CS(1-CS)/(alpha+beta+1).

name: Low-Precision Error Suppression
algorithm: Withhold model revision entirely where the computed gain falls below a configured floor rather than applying an arbitrarily small revision; record each withheld contradiction in the Chapter 17 contradiction index so a pattern of individually-insignificant errors against one attribute stays queryable.
rule: Revision is withheld where gain < configured floor; withheld contradictions are retained, not discarded.

name: Physical Constraint Enforcement
algorithm: Evaluate every registered physical constraint whose applicability predicate a candidate scene completion satisfies; refuse the completion where the residual exceeds tolerance and regenerate with the implicated field left unspecified, so a completion with an acknowledged gap is returned in preference to a physically impossible one; constraints are evaluated before plausibility scoring and a refused completion never appears in the ranked output at any score.
rule: Admissible iff |residual| <= tolerance, tolerance taken relative to the magnitude of the conserved quantity.

name: Constraint Residual Computation
algorithm: Compute the expected value of a constrained quantity from the registered closed-form residual expression in SI base units and compare against the completion's asserted value; record the refusal with constraint id, residual, tolerance and implicated field so a wrongly-parameterised constraint is detectable by its refusal rate rather than quietly suppressing correct inference.
rule: Expected position under gravitational constraint h1 = h0 - 0.5*g*t^2 with g = 9.80665 m/s^2; residual is the asserted value less h1.

name: Public API Layer
algorithm: Expose seven programmatic interfaces (content, query, rights, layout, assessment, edition, semantic); each resolves a scope description before traversal, no parameter widens it, an out-of-scope record yields the response for a non-existent record, and the layer carries its own Chapter 8 safety gate as an operation layer; calls are metered per calling identity and a call over budget is refused rather than served at reduced priority.
rule: A call is served only where the calling identity's metered budget is not exceeded; refusal is by budget, never by throttling.
worked_expression: =IF(120<=150,"Within slice budget; served","Refused - slice budget exceeded")

name: Plugin Architecture
algorithm: Register a third-party component against a declared capability set on the Source Connector Registry contract; the plugin reaches knowledge only through §105.1 interfaces within the executing identity's scope, holds no direct Fact Graph or Ledger access, is refused at registration if it declares any safety operation, cannot participate in the improvement pipeline, and its output is labelled, quarantined and not citable as grounding; activation and suspension require a named human operator.
rule: Registration is refused where the declared capability set includes any safety-evaluation operation.

name: Interface Versioning
algorithm: Version every interface; refuse a request omitting a version rather than defaulting it; deprecate for a configured support interval with a deprecation indication, then retire naming the successor; a field may be added or deprecated within a version, while removal or a change of type or meaning requires a new version; a citation issued under an earlier version remains valid.
rule: A request is served only where the requested version is registered and not retired.

name: Collaborative Reading
algorithm: Establish a session shared by several readers over one work; present a shared view comprising the intersection of participants' scope descriptions, never the union; a record traversable by one participant and not another is absent and its absence is not reported; annotations keep their own ACLs; queries resolve against the intersection so no participant receives a citation another cannot open.
rule: Shared view size is the intersection of participant scopes, not the union.

name: AR Overlay Presentation
algorithm: Anchor displayed Fact Units with citations to physical objects in a live camera feed as a presentation surface only, under the unchanged vocabulary constraint; exclude person and animal classifications entirely at any confidence; capture and derive no gaze, dwell, head-pose or attention signal and expose none to commerce or plugins; display no overlay where object identification does not clear its threshold.
rule: A person- or animal-classified result is never anchored, at any confidence and in any configuration.

name: Voice Navigation
algorithm: Accept spoken command and query input under explicit session-scoped revocable consent, distinct from prosodic analysis; route the transcription through the Language Command Router separating query from operational intent; request clarification below the confidence threshold rather than selecting an interpretation; discard audio after transcription; derive no voiceprint or biometric identifier; require second-modality confirmation for any state-changing instruction.
rule: Intent is applied only where classification clears the configured confidence threshold under active consent.

name: Spoiler Protection
algorithm: Record a reader progress marker and a narrative position for each Fact Unit of the work; bound the reader's scope description by the marker so a later-disclosed record is not traversable rather than masked in a rendered answer; state that an answer lies beyond the current position without disclosing its content; reader election with an author-configurable default, never applied to an instructor, researcher or author over their own work.
rule: A Fact Unit is traversable only where its narrative position does not exceed the reader's progress marker.
worked_expression: =IF(14<=22,"Within reader position; shown","Masked - beyond reader position")

name: Learner Progress Tracking
algorithm: Record position reached, items attempted, responses submitted and outcomes scored against the Fact Units the items were generated from; compute mastery as the proportion of objective-attributable items answered correctly against a threshold; bound instructor visibility by a time-scoped class grant so expiry removes it without further action; generate no aptitude inference, forecast or comparative ranking, and admit no progress record as a calibration subject.
rule: Mastery = correct items attributable to the objective / items attempted, against the configured threshold.

name: LMS Integration
algorithm: Connect a learning management system through the Source Connector Registry under a declared capability set; refuse an undeclared operation at the boundary rather than attempting it; a roster read establishes instructor grant scope and confers no entitlement; a grade write transmits the outcome alone with no Fact Unit, response text or history; record every transmission with connector identity, capability exercised and fields sent.
rule: An operation proceeds only where its capability is declared in the registered connector contract.

name: Multi-Edition Print Layout
algorithm: Compose a work into paginated print-ready form per edition from common Fact Units through regeneration, so an edition is a rendering rather than a copy; perform rights validation for territory, quantity and interval before composition and carry a reference to it in the composed form; reproduce wording-operative spans verbatim with non-operative glosses marked; compose accessible equivalents at the same production stage; keep pagination deterministic so page references stay valid.
rule: Composition proceeds only where rights validation permits print reproduction in the requested territory, quantity and interval.
worked_expression: =IF(AND(1=1,3<=3),"Print export authorized","Refused - rights or edition count")

name: Certification
algorithm: Issue a credential on both a measured outcome meeting the configured threshold and an identity established to the issuer's standard; carry as provenance the objectives assessed, items presented, source Fact Units, thresholds applied and issuing identity; permit third-party verification of issuance and non-revocation without disclosing the holder's responses; attest to the measured outcome and nothing further; record revocation rather than deleting.
rule: Issuance requires threshold satisfaction AND identity establishment; neither alone suffices.

name: Rights and Licensing Portal
algorithm: Expose the licence and entitlement mechanism through a portal under the existing role model and time-scoped grants; the portal renders capability and confers none; rights holders view licences, outstanding entitlements and the audit record, operators administer seats and assignment within role scope, grantees hold a read-only view of grants over them; record every action with acting identity and stated reason; a revocation takes effect at the next query execution.
rule: A portal action is available only where the acting role already holds that capability elsewhere.

name: Hyperedge Attention
algorithm: Where a reasoning operation traverses a hyperedge linking several Fact Units, weight each constituent's contribution by its own ConfidenceScore and its degree of corroboration with the hyperedge's other constituents, rather than contributing equally regardless of reliability. Under §41.6.2 those two quantities are the Beta posterior mean and the accumulated evidence count, so the weight is the product of the two parameters the confidence representation already holds. A weighting refinement over the World Model Domain's existing hypergraph traversal, not a new traversal mechanism.
rule: Constituent weight = CS_i * (alpha_i + beta_i), normalized across the hyperedge's constituents.

name: Attractor-Based Hyperedge Completion
algorithm: Complete a partially-observed hyperedge — a geometric contour with observed points and gaps — by applying the Attractor Network's existing convergence dynamics (§7.2.4) to the constituent set as a whole, converging toward the most consistent complete configuration given the observed constituents and their §53.7.1 attention weights. Distinct from WorldModel.Infer, which completes a general scene by Schema, Physics, Affordance and Relation rules: this is geometric, hyperedge-granular and convergence-based. It introduces no dynamical system of its own; it is Claim 6's mechanism applied at hyperedge granularity.
rule: Completion is admitted only where attention-weighted support for the converged configuration clears the configured floor.

name: Domain Transfer Matrix
algorithm: Assign every ordered pair of domains a permission of ALLOW, DENY or TRANSFORM-REQUIRED; evaluate it at each boundary crossing; treat a pair with no entry as DENY; record every crossing in the Provenance Ledger with source domain, target domain and permission applied. The denials carry the accuracy guarantees: D12 to D4 denied so analysis never grounds an answer, D13 to D4 and D7 denied so commerce never influences retrieval or generation, D9 to D2 denied so no surface bypasses the slice, D11 to D0 denied so governance cannot amend the Prime Directive.
rule: A crossing proceeds only where the matrix entry is ALLOW or a satisfied TRANSFORM-REQUIRED; an absent entry is DENY.

name: Query/Ingestion Path Separation
algorithm: Partition domains so the latency-critical query path (D8, D4, optionally D5, D7) and the batch ingestion path (D1, D2, D3, D6, D5) intersect only at D0 and D2; resolve contention at D0 by safety-category priority and at D2 by storage tiering; keep extraction out of the retrieval domain so a retrieval never blocks on an extractor and an extraction never blocks on attractor convergence.
rule: Intersection of the query-path and ingestion-path domain sets must not exceed two (governance and substrate).
worked_expression: =IF(2<=2,"Path separation holds","Contention risk - shared domain on both paths")

name: Domain Slice Priority Ordering
algorithm: Meter each domain's operations as bounded compute-accounting units carrying that domain's identifier and fix scheduling priority by domain: D0 highest without exception, D13 lowest so contention omits the commercial region rather than delaying the answer, and latency-path domains ahead of batch-path domains; contain each domain's failure to its own capability, with a D0 failure halting the operation rather than allowing it to proceed unevaluated.
rule: Governance domain priority must strictly precede commerce domain priority in the scheduling order.
worked_expression: =IF(0<13,"Safety slice served ahead of commerce slice","Priority inversion")

name: Undiscriminated Hypothesis Detection
algorithm: Detect continuously where two hypotheses concerning a common subject have posteriors within the configured separation floor while each exceeds a minimum support count; mark the pair undiscriminated and invoke §97.8.2. A pair in which one hypothesis is weakly supported is under-evidenced rather than undiscriminated and is routed to the existing evidence-seeking mechanism instead.
rule: Undiscriminated where |P(H1) - P(H2)| < separation floor and both accumulated evidence counts exceed the minimum.
worked_expression: =IF(ABS(12/16-11/16)<0.15,"Undiscriminated - generate crucial instance","Separated; no instance required")

name: Discriminating Instance Selection
algorithm: For each obtainable candidate observation compute the magnitude of the difference between its likelihood under each hypothesis, and select the maximum; select irrespective of how probable either hypothesis considers the observation, so an observation both predict equally is never selected; withhold generation where no candidate clears the discrimination floor; emit a structured request stating both hypotheses' posteriors under presence and under absence, so the outcome is interpretable before the observation is obtained.
rule: discrimination(E) = |P(E|H1) - P(E|H2)|; the selected instance maximises it and must clear the discrimination floor.

name: Hybrid and Edge Deployment Topology
algorithm: Add hybrid topology (substrate and access domains in customer infrastructure, media and immersive assets in operator infrastructure, scope resolved customer-side and travelling with the request) and edge topology (frequency-selected cache near a reader concentration, holding no authority, answering only where the requester's scope admits every cached record consulted and escalating otherwise, performing no ingestion and constructing no scope); the Chapter 106 domain partition is invariant across all five topologies.
rule: An edge node serves from cache only where scope admits every cached record consulted and currency is verified; otherwise it escalates.
worked_expression: =IF(AND(1=1,45<=80),"Edge node serves from local cache","Escalate to origin mesh")

name: Media and Immersion Interfaces
algorithm: Extend the §105.1 interface set with a media interface returning deterministic transformations (semantic compression, expansion, colorization, resolution enhancement) carrying the provenance of the transformation, and an immersion interface returning scene descriptions assembled from spatially-detailed records; both resolve a scope before traversal, widen none, carry their own safety gate, capture no gaze or attention signal, and withhold rather than fabricate where detail is insufficient.
rule: An interface call is served only where the requested interface is a registered member of the interface set.

name: Domain Module Replacement
algorithm: Permit a domain's implementation to be exchanged where the replacement implements every interface the replaced domain exposed at each version still within its support interval, satisfies every transfer-matrix entry in which that domain appeared as source or target, and is admitted through the improvement-proposal mechanism with a named human approval; Domain 0 is a member of the permanently-excluded set and is not replaceable.
rule: Replacement admitted only where interface-version conformance and transfer-matrix conformance both hold.

name: Parallel Multilingual Presentation
algorithm: Present two or more language realizations of a work simultaneously, aligned by knowledge record rather than by page or sentence position, each generated from the same records so alignment is a property of shared provenance and cannot drift; a citation in either realization resolves to the same record; a record without a realization in one language shows as a gap rather than being filled from the other; wording-operative spans stay in source language in every realization with glosses rendered per target language.
rule: Alignment confidence is bounded by the least confident of the aligned realizations.

name: Tenant-Scoped Key Custody
algorithm: Scope each encryption key to a tenant or deployment so a key of one tenant decrypts no content of another; hold key material within a hardware or equivalent custody boundary where configured, so the system holds a handle and every use is a call across the boundary rather than a read of key material; the zero-knowledge reader-history election and the no-operator-key message channel classification are unchanged and are not weakened by the presence of a hardware module.
rule: A decryption proceeds only where a key scoped to the requesting tenant resolves.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"tenant-A","tenant-B"},"tenant-A")>0,"Key resolved for tenant","Refused - no tenant key")

name: Signed Provenance Ledger Verification
algorithm: Sign each provenance chain node under a deployment key in addition to its keyed checksum, so a third party holding the verification key can confirm that a recorded operation and its recorded safety evaluation are as written, without access to the producing system; verification establishes fidelity of the record and nothing about the correctness of the operation recorded.
rule: A ledger entry is admitted to a verification report only where its signature verifies against the deployment key.
worked_expression: =IF(0.88>=0.8,"Signature verified; entry admitted","Refused - ledger signature mismatch")

name: Reasoning Mode Classification
algorithm: Classify every inference as entailed (a conclusion following necessarily from admitted records) or conjectural; admit an entailed conclusion as a knowledge record with a derived-inference type and a confidence equal to the product of the contributing edge confidences; withhold a conjectural conclusion from admission and emit it with status PROPOSED, with no automated process configured to transition it to VALIDATED. Deduction may write to the knowledge store; induction and abduction may not.
rule: An inference is admitted as a record only where it is entailed; a conjectural inference is emitted PROPOSED and creates nothing.

name: Inductive Support Threshold
algorithm: Operate the evidence-integration layer: accumulate corroborating and contradicting evidence as posterior parameters, weight corroboration by source independence, elevate confidence for cross-modal agreement within a temporal window, hold a concept provisional until the consolidation count is met, and retain every contradiction too weak to revise the model so a pattern of individually-insignificant negatives stays queryable. A generalization is emitted only where subordinate support and evidential strength both clear their floors.
rule: A generalization is proposed only where the subordinate count clears the minimum and the supporting evidence exceeds the contradicting evidence.
worked_expression: =IF(AND(4>=3,0.78>0.62),"Inductive support sufficient; hypothesis proposed","Insufficient - no proposal")

name: Observation Diversity Measure
algorithm: Attribute every increment of the confidence parameters to a registered source class and compute the effective number of contributing classes as the reciprocal of the summed squared weight proportions; admit a corroboration from an already-dominant class at reduced weight; require a diversity floor as well as a count floor before proposing a generalization; attenuate precision-weighted revision where a contradiction's diversity approaches unity; and disclose concentration in an output relying on a record below the diversity threshold.
rule: D = 1 / sum_i (w_i / sum_j w_j)^2 over registered source classes; D=1 where all weight is in one class.

name: Context Modulation
algorithm: Modulate an already-admissible result for device class, network condition, session type and referenced environment record: select among entitled editions, offer an available media transformation, adapt layout, and supply a temporal or edition scoping hint. Where a context signal would select an unentitled edition, fall back to an entitled one and disclose the fallback. Rights enforcement is not an output of this layer; the Slice Resolver and rights validation decide availability before any modulation runs.
rule: A modulation is applied only where it leaves the admissible record set unchanged; otherwise it is refused.
worked_expression: =IF(AND(1=1,0=0),"Modulation applied within admissible set","Refused - would alter admissible set")

name: Perspective Modulation
