algorithm: Modulate framing by the role a requester elects for the session — reader, author, instructor, student, researcher, publisher, operator — selecting which relationships among admitted records surface first and how explanations are framed; a student sees learning pathways, an author revision pathways, a publisher rights pathways over identical records. Electing a perspective confers no capability: it frames the records the requester's own entitlement already admits.
rule: A perspective lens is applied where the elected role is registered; it alters ordering and framing, never the admitted set.

name: Ergonomic Modulation
algorithm: Modulate density, layout, legibility and emphasis from reading pace, interaction pattern, display and input characteristics, accessibility settings and the §50.4 ergonomic preference signals. A stated preference always takes precedence over an inferred signal. Compression selects among admissible records and shortens their expression without summarising beyond what they support. An inferred cognitive-load signal modulates presentation only, produces no record, and reaches no other layer, commerce or interface.
rule: Stated preference governs wherever a stated and an inferred signal bear on the same dimension.

name: Cultural Modulation
algorithm: Modulate for locale, regional convention, idiom and localized examples, selecting among admissible expressions and entitled territory-specific editions. The cultural profile is declared by the requester, by an operator, or by an explicitly selected locale — never inferred from a name, network address, query language, device locale or behaviour. Where no equivalent is registered for a locale, render plainly rather than substituting an unregistered equivalent.
rule: A cultural modulation applies only from a declared profile; an inferred profile is refused.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"declared","inferred"},"inferred")>0,"Refused - cultural profile must be declared","Declared profile applied")

name: Social Modulation
algorithm: Modulate pacing, shared position, shared annotation surfaces, register and formality for class, group-reading, collaborative-authoring and instructor-guided settings, operating strictly within the intersection of participants' scope descriptions so no participant is shown a record another's entitlement excludes and no absence is disclosed. A social annotation keeps its author's identity and its own ACL, which this layer does not widen; a group setting confers no entitlement.
rule: Social modulation operates within the intersection of participant scopes, never their union.

name: Interpretive Composition Order
algorithm: Compose the five modulations in fixed order over an already-admissible result — perspective, cultural, social, ergonomic, context — with Prime Directive review preceding and following the whole composition and overriding every layer. Composition is deterministic: identical result plus identical configuration yields identical modulated output. A stated preference overrides an inferred signal at any stage, and where two layers modulate one dimension incompatibly the later stage governs form and the earlier substance.
rule: Governance review precedes stage 1 and follows stage 6; a stated preference overrides an inferred signal at any stage.
worked_expression: =IF(0<1,"Safety modulation precedes all interpretive layers","Precedence inversion")

name: Response Feedback Admission
algorithm: Record every delivered response with its query, scope description, cited records and their confidence at delivery; admit a reader's report on that response as a knowledge record through the ordinary extraction path with the reporting identity as attributed source. A report against a cited record increments that record's contradicting parameter by the source's weight — it does not set confidence, supersede the record or remove it. The reporting identity counts as a source class, so ten reports from one identity weigh less than ten from ten. A report is never admissible as grounding for the subject matter it concerns.
rule: A contradicting report increments beta by the reporting source's reliability weight; confidence follows from §41.6.2 arithmetic.

name: Outcome Pairing and Subject Gate
algorithm: Admit an outcome observation recording what subsequently occurred in respect of a matter a response addressed, pair it with the response record, and refuse construction where the subject resolves to an individual natural person so no per-individual predictive record accumulates from operational use; institutional, organisational, system and aggregate-group subjects are admissible.
rule: Construction is refused where the resolved subject class is an individual natural person.

name: Delivered-Answer Calibration Score
algorithm: Compute over paired responses and outcomes the mean of squared differences between the confidence stated at delivery and the realised outcome, per domain and per confidence band, so a system well calibrated in one domain and poorly in another is not concealed by an aggregate; a finding of poor calibration is as reportable as one of good calibration and identifies where a confidence value should not be offered at its current precision.
rule: score = sum (c_i - o_i)^2 / n over paired responses and outcomes.

name: Confidence Band Calibration Gap
algorithm: Compute per confidence band the difference between the proportion of realised outcomes and the mean confidence stated in that band; raise a calibration finding where the magnitude reaches the configured tolerance; emit the finding as an improvement proposal to a named human reviewer rather than applying it, with the parameters governing the measurement itself held in the permanently-excluded set so the mechanism cannot adjust the terms on which it is judged.
rule: gap = observed outcome rate - mean stated confidence within the band; |gap| >= tolerance raises a finding.

name: Expressive Register Selection
algorithm: Select exactly one expressive register per response from a governed, versioned set — formal, plain, academic, instructional, narrative, supportive, authoritative — resolved before generation as an element of the Generation Directive and distinct from audience level and discipline mode; refuse an unregistered register rather than approximating it. A register governs voicing only: it alters no admitted record, no confidence value and no permissible vocabulary, so the authoritative register never removes a hedge a confidence value requires and the supportive register never softens an assertion the records state plainly.
rule: A register is admitted only where it is a member of the registered set; voicing is governed by register, assertion by confidence.

name: Affective Register Gate
algorithm: Select the supportive register only on a stated preference, a configured default for an accessibility or discipline configuration, or the existing consent-gated prosodic signal; never by inference from word choice, punctuation, query length, error rate, retry behaviour or interaction timing, and construct no record of an inferred affective state. Where in effect it acknowledges the requester's stated position, reduces density and avoids imperative construction, while withholding no answer the records support and altering no confidence value.
rule: The affective register requires a stated preference, a configured default, or a consented signal; an inferred affective state is refused.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"stated","consented-signal"},"inferred-from-text")>0,"Affective register applied","Refused - affective register requires a stated or consented signal")

name: Media-Integrated Expression
algorithm: Carry media assets inside a grounded response rather than alongside it, including an asset only where a knowledge record of the stabilized set references it and delivering it with a citation resolving it to that record; withhold an asset supporting no admitted record and an asset whose referencing record the scope description excluded, so no asset conveys what the text could not assert. A transformed asset carries its transformation provenance; an interpretive modulation selects among includable assets and cannot render one includable; an accessible equivalent accompanies each included asset at the same production stage.
rule: An asset is included only where it is referenced by an admitted record within the scope description, and is delivered with that record's citation.
worked_expression: =IF(AND(1=1,0.91>=0.6),"Media asset admitted with citation","Refused - asset does not support a cited record")

name: Sentence Aggregation
algorithm: Realize propositions sharing a subject and joined by a conjunctive Narrative Graph edge as one sentence with a coordinated predicate, up to a configured maximum; refuse aggregation where confidence values differ beyond tolerance so a weakly-supported proposition is never qualified by coordination with a well-supported one; carry every constituent proposition's citation on the combined sentence so each clause remains resolvable to its record.
rule: Aggregate where shared-subject propositions number at least two and their confidence values fall within the configured tolerance.

name: Referring Expression Selection
algorithm: Realize an entity in full registered form at first mention within a discourse unit and in reduced form thereafter; restore full form where a same-type entity intervenes or a new discourse unit begins. Ambiguity is decided by Ontology Mesh type rather than surface form, and full form is used wherever the test is indeterminate, since an unnecessary repetition costs a reader nothing and an ambiguous pronoun costs them the sentence.
rule: Reduced form is permitted only where no same-type entity intervenes since the last full mention within the discourse unit.

name: Connective Emission
algorithm: Emit a connective marking the relation type of the Narrative Graph edge joining two sequentially-realized propositions — causal, adversative, expository, illustrative, sequential, concessive — selecting within the class by expressive register and sentence position so no connective recurs mechanically; emit none where no typed edge joins the propositions, since asserting an unbacked relation would assert what no record supports.
rule: A connective is emitted only where a typed edge joins the two propositions; the class follows the edge type.

name: Given-Before-New Ordering
algorithm: Order constituents within a sentence so that material already realized in the preceding sentence precedes material new to the response, computed from the response's own prior content rather than from general familiarity; yield absolutely to target-language syntax, and exempt wording-operative spans, which are reproduced in source order because reordering would alter the wording that carries force.
rule: A constituent realized in the preceding sentence is ordered ahead of one not yet realized, where target-language syntax permits.

name: Fingerprint-Bounded Lexical Variation
algorithm: Substitute a registered synonym for a recurring term only where the proposition's semantic fingerprint is unchanged by the substitution, making variation verifiable rather than a source of drift; draw synonymy from resources registered under §4.9 so every admitted substitution is licensed and recorded; never vary a term inside a wording-operative span, a registered canonical entity name, or a governed discipline term.
rule: A substitution is admitted only where the canonicalized triple's semantic fingerprint is preserved.
worked_expression: =IF(0.94>=0.9,"Substitution admitted; fingerprint preserved","Refused - fingerprint would change")

name: Commercial Eligibility Determination
algorithm: Determine eligibility of a commercial item from four already-established facts about the request — registered rights, recorded territory, delivered edition, device class — and from no other input; inferred ergonomic, cognitive-load and affective signals remain unavailable to commercial selection, a declared cultural profile may bound eligibility where an item's registration is locale-specific; where the eligible set is empty the commercial region is omitted and the omission is not disclosed, since a region that reports having nothing to show conveys information about the requester.
rule: Eligibility is computed from declared request facts only; any inferred personal signal is barred from the determination.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"rights","territory","edition","device"},"cognitive-load")>0,"Refused - inferred signal barred from commerce","Eligibility computed from declared facts")

name: Placement Class and Density Ceiling
algorithm: Present a commercial item only in a registered placement class — inline between sections, edition-aligned, media-adjacent, or spatial within an immersive presentation — each a labelled region never interleaved with response propositions so position distinguishes answer from commerce; bound placements per response and per session by a configured density ceiling, omitting rather than deferring an item that exceeds it; capture and derive no gaze, dwell, head-pose or attention signal in any class.
rule: A placement is admitted only where the running count remains within the configured per-response and per-session ceiling.
worked_expression: =IF(AND(1=1,3<=5),"Placement admitted within density ceiling","Refused - density ceiling exceeded")

name: Advertiser Provenance Record
algorithm: Register each commercial item with the presenting party's verified identity, the rights permitting presentation, covered territories, validity interval and registering operator, refusing registration where any is absent; record each presentation in the Provenance Ledger with item, placement class, occasioning concept identifier, eligibility facts and computed score, so a presentation is auditable against the rules in force at the time. A commercial item is not a knowledge record: not citable, not traversable, contributing to no confidence value, and any assertion within it is labelled as the presenting party's.
rule: Selection score = weighted sum of relevance, source-priority and bid factors with weights summing to unity; recorded per presentation.

name: Territory Price Registration
algorithm: Register each commerce object — edition, media asset, immersive experience, bundle, institutional or classroom licence, supplemental pack — with the rights permitting sale, the territories in which it may be sold, and a price per territory and currency; withhold the offer in a territory for which no price is registered rather than offering at a default.
rule: An offer is made only where a price is registered for the request's territory and currency.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"US","CA","UK"},"US")>0,"Territory price applied","Refused - no price registered for territory")

name: Transaction Reconciliation
algorithm: Perform purchase, rent, subscribe, unlock, upgrade or transfer against a registered commerce object, producing a transaction record carrying acting identity, object, action, price and currency, territory, rights validation relied upon and a ledger reference; supersede rather than delete a prior entitlement on upgrade; refuse a transaction that cannot be reconciled against an entitlement change rather than recording it pending, so entitlement state and transaction history cannot diverge; a token whose state disagrees with the entitlement record raises a divergence finding, the entitlement remaining authoritative.
rule: A transaction is recorded only where the entitlement change reconciles exactly; an unreconcilable transaction is refused.
worked_expression: =IF(0=0,"Ledger balanced; transaction recorded","Refused - transaction not reconcilable")

name: Commandable Equipment Registration
algorithm: Register each commandable unit of the capture and inspection class — pan-tilt-zoom head, lighting fixture, bounded-volume capture drone, inspection arm, mobile capture base, positioning stage — with its kinematic envelope, velocity and force limits and operating volume; refuse emission to a unit missing any of these and to any class outside scope. The §96.8 vehicle prohibition is unchanged: vehicle telemetry remains analysis-only and no vehicle control interface exists.
rule: A command is emitted only to a registered unit of an in-scope class whose registration carries envelope, limits and volume.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"pan-tilt-head","capture-drone","inspection-arm"},"vehicle")>0,"Refused - class outside authorized scope","Equipment class in scope")

name: Session Authorization for Actuation
algorithm: Grant command authority per session rather than per command, recorded with the authorizing operator's identity, covered units, permitted volume, permitted task classes and expiry; halt emission on expiry rather than prompting mid-motion; effect revocation before the next command rather than at plan end; confer no capability over unnamed equipment; record in the Provenance Ledger so every command traces to its authorization and grantor.
rule: Emission proceeds only while the session authorization is unexpired, unrevoked, and covers the unit, volume and task class.

name: Pre-Emission Constraint Veto
algorithm: Evaluate every command before emission against operating volume, kinematic envelope, velocity and force limits, minimum obstacle clearance, human exclusion distance, inter-unit swept-volume overlap and recording-restricted zones; withhold any violating command unconditionally — not emitted at reduced priority, not emitted with a warning, and not automatically modified into a permissible command.
rule: A command is emitted only where every constraint test passes; a single violation withholds emission outright.

name: Safety-Only Human Proximity Detection
algorithm: Detect persons solely to compute exclusion clearance along a commanded trajectory; retain no detection beyond the instant of evaluation, admit none to any result set, make none queryable and expose none to any other mechanism. This preserves the standing exclusion of person classifications from result sets while allowing a machine to avoid people: a system that could not see a person could not avoid one, and one that remembers seeing them is a surveillance capability.
rule: Governing clearance is the lesser of measured distance to a detected person and the configured exclusion distance.

name: Halt Path Independent of Reasoning
algorithm: Emit a halt on clearance or proximity breach, stale equipment state, authorization expiry or revocation, sensor-stream loss, or explicit request; evaluate the halt directly from equipment state and constraint set without traversing retrieval, stabilization, generation or interpretive modulation, so it cannot be delayed by a query in progress; place the unit in its registered safe state and require an explicit resume; record every halt so repeated halts on a unit or task class are queryable.
rule: A halt triggers where measured clearance falls to or below the configured minimum, evaluated outside the reasoning path.

name: Assistive Contact Registration and Hazard Analysis
function: Assistive Contact Registration and Hazard Analysis
algorithm: Register a unit making intentional contact with a person under an authorization class disjoint from Chapter 114's, in one of three classes — servant (carries or hands over), assistant (supplements movement), carrier (bears weight); refuse registration where a hazard analysis for the intended task, user and environment has not been completed and recorded with the assessor's identity, since every later requirement is meaningless if the hazards were never enumerated. A device registered under both chapters is governed by the authorization under which a given command was emitted.
rule: Registration is refused absent a recorded hazard analysis; the two authorization classes confer nothing on one another.

name: Two-Party Contact Authorization
algorithm: Require a deployment authorization from an identified operator and a contact consent from the assisted person concurrently, neither substituting for the other: deployment establishes contact is permissible, consent establishes it is wanted. Consent is bounded to task class and interval and does not persist across sessions. Withdrawal by the assisted person through any registered channel halts within the registered stopping interval and cannot be overridden by an operator, a representative or a task in progress; an operator halt is not a withdrawal and does not require re-consent.
rule: Contact proceeds only while both authorizations are held; a withdrawal by the assisted person governs absolutely.

name: Contact Force and Pressure Limits
algorithm: Replace the exclusion-distance constraint with a contact constraint set: force and pressure limits registered per body region so a within-limit force over a reduced area is not thereby permitted, registered contact regions, a contact velocity below free-motion velocity, consent currency, and absence of any configuration from which the person could not be released; a violation halts rather than adjusts. Registered values derive from the hazard analysis and the governing standard's biomechanical limits rather than from figures stated in this specification.
rule: Measured force and pressure at each contact region must not exceed the limit registered for that region.
worked_expression: =IF(28<=65,"Within registered limit for contact region","Halt - force limit exceeded")

name: Release as Default Failure State
algorithm: Design and register every unit so that power loss, control-signal loss, safety-path fault or any halt releases the person rather than retaining them — a gripper that holds on power loss traps whom it was assisting. A weight-bearing unit is excepted only where its registration records redundant support: its safe state is controlled retention with an alert and a bounded interval for transferring support. The release path does not traverse the reasoning path and must operate where that path is unavailable entirely.
rule: Any fault or halt yields release; retention is permitted only for a registered weight-bearing unit with redundant support.

name: Support Redundancy for Weight-Bearing
algorithm: Maintain support for a person whose weight is borne through at least two independent means so no single failure withdraws support; a unit registered without redundant support may not bear weight. Contact is never initiated from inference — only on request by the assisted person, by an operator under held consent, or within a consented task sequence — and no record of the person's body, movement, capability or dependency is constructed, retained or made queryable.
rule: A weight-bearing command requires at least two independent support means confirmed present.
worked_expression: =IF(2>=2,"Redundant support confirmed","Refused - single point of support")

name: Energy Descent and Termination
algorithm: Ground convergence in the monotonic decrease of E = -1/2 sum over distinct pairs of w_ij s_i s_j, so termination follows from the descent rather than from an iteration bound and a given initial configuration under given weights reaches an identical stable state every execution; distinguish termination from uniqueness, the capacity bound making a spurious state improbable rather than impossible.
rule: E = -1/2 sum_{i<j} w_ij s_i s_j; each accepted update strictly decreases E, so no configuration recurs.

name: Bounded Frame Reconstruction
algorithm: Complete a partially-observed sensor frame by converging observed regions to the nearest stored configuration; bound the completed region's confidence above by the lesser of the observed regions' confidence and the stored configuration's; render it inadmissible as grounding so it supports no assertion and moves no confidence value; produce nothing where convergence fails within the iteration ceiling and report the gap instead.
rule: Reconstructed confidence = MIN(observed confidence, stored-configuration confidence).

name: Reconstruction Marking
algorithm: Mark every reconstructed region as reconstructed so it is never presented as observed; a frame carrying an acknowledged hole is truthful, a frame whose hole has been filled with an inference presented as observation is not.
rule: A region is presented as observed only where it was observed; a converged region carries the reconstructed marking.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"observed","reconstructed"},"reconstructed")>0,"Marked reconstructed; not presented as observed","Observed region")

name: Difference-Preserving Alignment
algorithm: Align timelines, sequences and editions by convergence only where the divergence falls below the configured threshold, treating that as extraction variance; preserve a divergence at or above threshold as a genuine difference and preserve any divergence that cannot be classified, since erasing a real difference costs a reader the fact while preserving a spurious one costs a footnote; record incompatible content between preserved editions in the contradiction index.
rule: Converge where divergence < threshold; preserve where divergence >= threshold or is unclassifiable.

name: Control Oscillation Fault
algorithm: Damp oscillation and jitter in a control signal by convergence, evaluating the damped command against the constraint set identically to an undamped one so damping never brings a command within a limit it would otherwise exceed; where control-error sign changes reach the configured frequency across a window, raise a control fault, cease damping and invoke the halt path, because a persistently damped oscillation is a concealed fault rather than a stabilised loop.
rule: Sign changes of the control error across the window >= configured frequency raises a fault and halts.

name: One-Hop Concept Adjacency Set
algorithm: Supply commercial selection with the query's resolved concept identifier together with concepts one edge away, computed at the point of supply after retrieval, stabilization and generation complete; restrict to adjacency-bearing edge types — subsumption, part-whole, registered general association — excluding causal, temporal and contradiction edges, since a concept related as a cause or a contradiction is not thereby one the reader wants offered; perform no traversal from an adjacent concept, so two-edge concepts never enter the set.
rule: An adjacent concept is admitted only where its connecting edge type is registered as adjacency-bearing and lies within one hop.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"IS-A","PART-OF","RELATED-TO"},"CAUSES")>0,"Edge type permitted for adjacency","Refused - edge type not in adjacency set")

name: Adjacency Scope Confinement
algorithm: Exclude from the adjacency set any concept lying outside the requester's scope description, and do not signal the exclusion, so the existence of a concept beyond a requester's entitlement cannot be inferred from what was advertised to them; the adjacency set is recomputed per request and retained no longer than the request.
rule: An adjacent concept enters the set only where the requester's scope description admits it.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"in-scope","out-of-scope"},"out-of-scope")>0,"Refused - adjacent concept outside requester scope","Adjacent concept admitted")

name: Attenuated Adjacency Relevance
algorithm: Let an adjacent concept participate in the relevance factor alone and never in eligibility, so an ineligible item does not become eligible by matching a neighbour; attenuate relevance computed through adjacency relative to relevance against the query concept itself, so a direct match outranks a neighbour match; leave the three existing weights unchanged and summing to unity.
rule: Score = 0.4*relevance + 0.3*source-priority + 0.3*bid, with adjacency-derived relevance attenuated below direct relevance.

name: Convergence Regime Disclosure
algorithm: Operate each network under exactly one recorded convergence regime and return with every derived output an indication of which was in effect: a spectral-norm contraction guaranteeing a unique equilibrium by construction, or a capacity bound below the retrieval-phase boundary rendering a differing converged state improbable rather than impossible. The two support different statements about an identical output and a recipient cannot distinguish them from the output itself. The election is a member of the permanently-excluded subsystem set, changed only by an operator and recorded with that operator's identity, so no internally-generated proposal can elect the weaker regime to obtain freer weight updates.
rule: Exactly one regime is in effect per network; the output discloses which, and the election cannot be altered from within the system.

name: Trial Budget and Scheduling
algorithm: Meter every trial as a bounded compute-accounting slice in a trial category with a per-interval budget; schedule trial slices below safety evaluation without exception, below requester-serving slices and below ingestion; defer a trial exceeding its allocation rather than serving it at reduced priority, so a campaign cannot degrade the system it measures. Trials are free of physical consequence — nothing wears, is damaged or crashes — but not free of cost; the cost shifts from equipment and risk to compute and scheduling, and is recorded so an operator decides with a figure in front of them.
rule: A trial executes only where the trial-category budget for the interval is not exceeded; otherwise it defers.
worked_expression: =IF(AND(2400<=5000,1=1),"Test budget within allocation","Deferred - would contend with production slices")

name: Trial Isolation and Non-Application
algorithm: Execute trials against an isolated corpus and configuration: construct no production knowledge record, adjust no production confidence value, emit no command to physical equipment outside simulation, deliver no output to a requester. Record results as trial records excluded from ordinary scope descriptions. Apply nothing — a finding is emitted as a proposal requiring a named human approval, and ten million trials produce the same class of output as one: evidence for a person to act on. Regression blocks rather than reports: a case passing before a change and failing after it withholds the change.
rule: A change is applied only where no previously-passing trial case regresses; a regression withholds the change.

name: Trial Space Coverage
algorithm: Enumerate the trial space per layer rather than sampling it, execute cases from the enumeration, and record coverage as the executed proportion together with an enumeration of the cases not executed, so the residue is stated rather than left as an unexamined assumption. Exhaustive mode is where the absence of physical cost pays: a space prohibitive to explore with equipment can be explored completely.
rule: Coverage = executed cases / enumerated trial space, with uncovered cases listed individually.

name: Determinism Verification
algorithm: Measure determinism as the proportion of repeated trials over an identical corpus state and configuration yielding an identical semantic fingerprint; a measurement spanning a corpus that changed between trials is not a determinism measurement, since confidence legitimately moves as evidence accumulates. Any value below unity is a defect rather than a tolerance. The §96.9 probes applied inward measure the claimed property directly rather than a proxy.
rule: Determinism = identical-fingerprint repeats / total repeats over an unchanged corpus state; the only passing value is 1.0.
worked_expression: =IF(1000/1000>=0.999,"Determinism verified across trial set","Defect - determinism not reproduced")

name: Simulation Is Not Clearance
algorithm: Treat a trial result concerning equipment as evidence about a model, never as clearance to operate: clearance comes from hazard analysis, verification and certification on the specific unit in its configuration. Where a simulation and a physical trial disagree, the physical trial governs and the disagreement is recorded as a finding about the simulation. A campaign may contribute to a hazard analysis as one input; it may not conclude one.
rule: Operation is cleared only by unit certification; a simulation pass, at any scale, does not substitute.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"simulation-pass","unit-certification"},"unit-certification")>0,"Cleared for operation","Refused - simulation is not clearance")

name: Graspable Object Registration
algorithm: Register each graspable object with mass, permitted grip force, fragility limit and admissible contact regions; refuse to grasp an unregistered object rather than inferring grip force from appearance, since an inference about how hard to squeeze something errs destructively and immediately. Apply the least of the unit's force ceiling, the object's fragility limit, and the computed requirement raised by the configured margin — the margin applied before the limits, so it can never carry force above one.
rule: Applied force = MIN(unit ceiling, fragility limit, required force x (1 + margin)).

name: Slip Response and Controlled Release
algorithm: Detect slip from divergence between commanded and observed object position during a held grasp; increase applied force toward the lesser of unit ceiling and fragility limit and no further; where slip continues at that bound, release under control rather than tightening, recording object, force at release and observed slip rate. The fragility limit is a limit, not a target: an object that will not be held within it is an object not to be held.
rule: On slip, force rises to MIN(ceiling, fragility); continued slip at that bound triggers controlled release.

name: Gripper Opens on Fault
algorithm: Register every manipulator so power loss, control-signal loss, safety-path fault or any halt opens the gripper. Plan each grasp so the fall path is unobstructed before the grasp is made, refusing trajectories whose release path is obstructed; on an obstruction entering during a held grasp, move to the nearest pose with a clear path and, failing that, retain and raise a fault. A dropped object is a cost; a crushed object, a trapped hand and an object no one can command are worse.
rule: Any fault or halt opens the gripper; retention is permitted only where the release path is obstructed and no clear pose exists.

name: Handover Release Condition
algorithm: Perform handover under the Chapter 115 authorization, presenting the object within reach and applying no force toward the person; release on detected support sustained across the configured interval, and on timeout lower the object under control to a registered surface rather than releasing into the air. Never pull, never resist a person taking the object, never re-grasp what a person has taken, and never press an object against anyone.
rule: Release occurs only on sustained detected support; absent it, controlled lowering rather than release.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"stable-support","no-support"},"stable-support")>0,"Release to recipient","Retain - controlled lowering on timeout")

name: Navigable Region Registration
algorithm: Register a navigable region — travelable surfaces, boundaries, excluded zones — in place of a fixed operating volume, since free space in a shared corridor changes faster than a plan can be recomputed. Maintain a continuously-updated clearance model as session-scoped working state, never admitted as a knowledge record, and halt motion where the model exceeds its staleness bound.
rule: Motion proceeds only within the registered navigable region and only on a clearance model within its staleness bound.

name: Clearance-Bounded Speed
algorithm: Bound commanded speed by the lesser of the unit's registered maximum and a configured coefficient times the clearance ahead, so the unit slows as space closes rather than holding speed until an obstacle forces a stop; stopping distance at every permitted speed stays below the clearance that permitted it. No task parameter, priority or deadline raises the coefficient — a machine that hurried when late would be fastest exactly when its planning was worst.
rule: Permitted speed = MIN(registered maximum, coefficient x clearance).

name: Unconditional Yield
algorithm: Yield to a person on every path conflict: stop or withdraw along the path already travelled, never routing around at speed, never signalling for accommodation, never computing which party should give way — a person who cannot predict a machine cannot avoid it. Resolve unit-to-unit conflicts by registered ordering rather than negotiation, faulting both on persistent deadlock. Never maintain a following distance behind a person.
rule: Where a person's path conflicts with the unit's, the unit yields without exception.

name: Motion-Only Clearance Envelope
algorithm: Compute the occupied envelope for a person from observed position and velocity over a short window and from nothing else: no identity, no history beyond the window, no retention past the interval governed, and no availability to any other mechanism or interface. Where observed motion does not support an envelope, treat the full reachable region as occupied rather than assuming continuation, since an assumption about where someone will go is what produces a collision when they do otherwise.
rule: The envelope derives from observed motion alone; identity may not inform it.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"observed-motion","identity"},"identity")>0,"Refused - identity may not inform the envelope","Envelope computed from motion alone")

name: Stop Rather Than Relax
algorithm: Where no path satisfies the constraint set, stop: do not reduce a clearance requirement to find a path, do not proceed slowly through a sub-minimum clearance, do not select a least-violating trajectory. Report the obstruction with the clearance model after the configured interval and await an operator. A gate reached often is a gate under pressure to become a preference, which is why this is restated for a condition that will invoke it frequently.
rule: A path is admitted only where its clearance meets the configured minimum; otherwise the unit stops.
worked_expression: =IF(0.28>=0.35,"Path admitted","Stop - no path satisfies the clearance minimum")

name: Predictive Level Registration
algorithm: Maintain four hierarchically ordered expectation levels — lexical (the next element within a record), sequential (the next record given a sequence), conceptual (an instance attribute given its concept), invariant (a regularity of the world model) — each predicting within its own scope and never predicting what a level above it predicts.
rule: An expectation is evaluated only at a registered level of the hierarchy.

name: Lowest-Level Error Attribution
algorithm: Attribute a prediction error to the lowest level whose residual accounts for the configured share of total residual, applying revision at that level alone and passing nothing upward; a mis-parsed sentence says nothing about physics. Without this rule a mis-read unit propagates until it perturbs a physical constraint, and a system revising invariants on parsing errors becomes less reliable the more it reads.
rule: Level share = level residual / total residual; attribution goes to the lowest level clearing the configured share.

name: Escalation Gate
algorithm: Escalate to a level only where every level below it fails the share test, so a conceptual revision requires lexical and sequential residuals below the share and an invariant revision requires all three below it; an invariant is revised only where the observation survived every cheaper explanation. Revision magnitude at the attributed level remains governed by precision weighting, so attribution fixes where and precision fixes how far.
rule: A level is attributed only where each lower level's residual falls below the configured share.
worked_expression: =IF(0.4884>=0.4,"Attribute to lowest accounting level","Escalate to next level")

name: Unattributed Error Retention
algorithm: Where no level clears the share, record the observation in the contradiction index and apply no revision anywhere — an error no level accounts for is a finding about the hierarchy, not an instruction to it; surface repeated unattributed errors against a common expectation as a pattern, since one is noise and a hundred is a missing level. No level revises a registered physical constraint; an apparently contradicting observation enters the index rather than relaxing it.
rule: An unattributed error is recorded and applied nowhere; physical constraints are never revised by observation.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"attributed","unattributed"},"unattributed")>0,"Recorded in contradiction index; no revision applied","Revision applied at attributed level")

name: Edge-Class Traversal Cost
algorithm: Assign each edge class a traversal cost and bound pre-activation by a budget in cost units rather than by hop count: semantic edges cheap because meaning stays informative over distance, editorial dearer because relevance decays across version boundaries, temporal dearest because adjacency in time is weak evidence of relatedness and a long walk gathers noise. Costs are registered configuration recorded with the response, never adjusted by the system from its own experience.
rule: Budget consumed = sum over classes of (hops x cost); traversal halts when the registered budget is exhausted.

name: Propagation Reach by Class
algorithm: Derive each edge class's reach from its cost against the traversal budget, so a query may reach widely through meaning and shallowly through time at the same cost as the reverse; traversal is bounded by construction rather than by a stopping heuristic, and the same query under the same cost table pre-activates the same set on every execution.
rule: Reach of a class = budget / cost per hop for that class.

name: Tri-Temporal Posture
algorithm: Resolve a query in exactly one of three postures and state which produced the answer: attested past under the attestation-horizon cutoff, live present reading the live layer over the committed layer, or projected future carrying a credible interval. Past and present results are ordinary knowledge records; a projected result is never admitted as a record and never grounds a subsequent generation. Where a response draws on more than one posture each proposition carries its own, so a difference between answers reads as a difference of posture rather than an inconsistency.
rule: A result is admissible as grounding only where its posture is attested-past or live-present; projected-future is labelled and withheld.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"past","present","future"},"future")>0,"Forecast - labelled, not admitted as record","Attested state - admissible")

name: Six-Dimensional Coherence
algorithm: Compute a coherence value across semantic, temporal, spatial, editorial, media and evidential dimensions, each derived from mechanisms already specified, and take the least of the six as governing rather than the mean, since a mean lets five strong dimensions conceal the one weak dimension that is the actual finding.
rule: coherence = MIN over the six dimensional values; the governing dimension is named with the result.

name: Coherence Classification
algorithm: Classify by the governing value against configured floors — stable, drifting, misaligned — always naming the dimension that produced the classification; distinguish two further states with different causes and remedies: incomplete, where a dimension cannot be computed for want of data, and contradictory, where two records assert incompatible content and a specific pair is recorded. Coherence informs and never gates: it adjusts no confidence, admits or excludes no record, and withholds no output.
rule: Stable at or above the upper floor; drifting between floors; misaligned below the lower floor.

name: Context Lock and Key
algorithm: Enumerate the context dimensions whose values must agree for the determinism guarantee to hold — device class, entitlement set, locale, expressive register, audience level, temporal posture, traversal cost table, convergence regime — compute a key over them and return it with the output. Identical keys mean the outputs must be identical and a difference is a defect; differing keys mean nothing is claimed. The enumeration is in the permanently-excluded set, since a mechanism able to unlock a dimension could restore apparent determinism by narrowing what determinism means.
rule: Determinism is asserted between two executions only where the context key computed over the locked dimensions is identical.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"device","entitlement","locale","register","audience","posture","costs","regime"},"session-time")>0,"Locked dimension - determinism claimed","Unlocked - determinism not claimed across this difference")

name: Relevance Gradient
algorithm: Compute at traversal time the rate of change of relevance across a record's neighbours within an edge class, and order traversal to prefer directions of lower gradient, since slowly-changing relevance marks a region of stable meaning while a sharp change marks a boundary beyond which traversal gathers material of a different kind. Computed from values the records already carry, stored nowhere, adding no schema field, and altering the order in which the §123.1 budget is spent rather than what is reachable within it.
rule: gradient = |relevance(a) - relevance(b)| across neighbours in an edge class; lower gradient is traversed first.

name: Substrate Output as a Modality
algorithm: Register a computational substrate — neuromorphic processor, memristive array, multi-electrode array — as a source under a declared capability and its output as a modality with its own independently-failing extractor, so a substrate that becomes unavailable removes one modality and leaves the rest operating; reduce its output to concept-level records before admission, retain no raw episode, pass the safety gate, calibrate confidence against the substrate's registered reliability, and treat the substrate as a source class so many readings from one array do not weigh as readings from many.
rule: A substrate output is ingested only where its modality and extractor are registered.

name: Registered Substrate Interpretation
algorithm: Admit a substrate output as a measurement of that substrate's behaviour; admit it as bearing on any other subject only through an interpretation registered in advance with its own provenance and reliability, revisable by an operator. Absent a registered interpretation the output is a measurement of the substrate and nothing more, since a response to a stimulus is evidence of what the substrate produced and not of what it was asked about.
rule: Derived confidence = MIN(substrate reliability, interpretation reliability) — no better than the weaker of instrument and reading.

name: Substrate Stimulation Dispatch
algorithm: Dispatch a stimulus to a registered substrate through its connector under a declared capability, refusing an undeclared capability at the boundary and recording each stimulus with its dispatching identity; emit no stimulus on an inference that stimulation would be useful, and let no substrate response adjust the parameters governing when it may be stimulated. Where a substrate comprises living tissue, the operating institution's governance and any review its jurisdiction requires apply; this specification authorises no substrate's operation.
rule: A substrate output is admitted as calibrated evidence only where it clears the configured confidence floor.
worked_expression: =IF(0.71>=0.6,"Substrate output admitted as calibrated evidence","Below floor - recorded, not admitted")

name: Analog Convergence Realization
algorithm: Perform the threshold update by the settling of a variable-conductance array rather than by computing it: activations applied as row potentials, weights as element conductances, the weighted sum as column current, the stable state read by comparing current against a reference. The mapping is exact rather than analogical — Ohm's and Kirchhoff's laws produce the summation — and the duration of one settling does not scale with network size, where a digital update of an 8,192-unit network performs 67,108,864 multiply-accumulates.
rule: Digital multiply-accumulates per update = N^2; one analog settling performs the same summation as a single physical operation.

name: Unique-Equilibrium Precondition
algorithm: Permit analog realization only under the §116.2 monotone parameterization, refusing an array operated under the capacity bound alone. Conductance elements cannot be manufactured exactly, so two arrays hold weight matrices differing by fabrication tolerance; under a capacity bound both converge but may settle to different stable states while each behaves correctly, whereas under a unique equilibrium both settle to the same one. Uniqueness ceases to be a strengthening and becomes the precondition.
rule: Analog operation is permitted only where the network's registered convergence regime is unique-equilibrium.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"unique-equilibrium"},"capacity-bounded")>0,"Analog realization permitted","Refused - analog realization requires the unique-equilibrium regime")

name: Cross-Array Agreement
algorithm: Register each array with its dimensions, conductance range, fabrication tolerance and read tolerance; resolve a column falling within tolerance of the threshold by a further settling rather than by rounding, and report unresolved with fallback to the digital path where it does not resolve; require two arrays on a common input under a common weight specification to agree within tolerance, raising a fault on divergence rather than averaging, since averaging two disagreeing results produces a state neither array reached and a state no array reached is not an attractor of either.
rule: Two arrays agree where |state_A - state_B| <= registered read tolerance; beyond it a fault is raised.
worked_expression: =IF(ABS(0.42-0.415)<=0.05,"Chips agree within tolerance","Divergence - device variation exceeds tolerance")

name: Cross-Array Agreement Under Variation
algorithm: Parameterize by spectral norm below unity rather than by diagonal dominance: a diagonal-dominance constraint collapses the state toward zero where a unit's sign is near-ambiguous, yielding a unique equilibrium carrying no information, whereas a contraction retains the structure the weights encode. Simulated over 64 units holding six patterns, two matrices differing by 5% conductance variation settled differently on 30.5% of inputs under the capacity bound and 0.5% under a contraction at spectral norm 0.9 — recorded as a simulation result, not a hardware measurement.
rule: Disagreement rate between two varied weight matrices is materially lower under a spectral contraction than under the capacity bound.

name: Engine-Specific Prompt Composition
algorithm: Compose a prompt from knowledge records through the regeneration mechanism under the vocabulary constraint, adding semantic markers naming the concepts to address, extraction instructions specifying the return form, and alignment constraints stating the target record schema; compose per engine from a registered profile recording accepted input form, context bound, declared capabilities and reliability. Composition is deterministic, so an identical request under an identical profile yields an identical prompt and a differing reply is attributable to the engine rather than to the asking.
rule: Confidence of a converted record = MIN(engine reliability, extraction-instruction reliability).

name: Reply Conversion to Knowledge Records
algorithm: Dispatch through a registered connector under a declared capability, refusing an unregistered engine or undeclared capability at the boundary; rate-limit and batch under compute accounting, deferring over-budget dispatches; terminate on failure, malformed reply or over-bound reply without producing a partial record. Normalize and segment the reply into individual assertions, convert each to a candidate record validated against its type's machine definition, and assign a temporal anchor from elicitation time, a semantic fingerprint and a provenance reference naming prompt, engine, version and position within the reply.
rule: An assertion is converted only where it validates against the machine definition of its type; otherwise it is refused at construction.

name: Derivation Marking and Disclosure
algorithm: Carry the engine identity as an unmodifiable, unremovable field of the record schema, and disclose it in any citation resolving to that record, so a reader following a citation is told the assertion was generated by a named engine from a recorded prompt rather than asserted by an authored source. Prevents the failure in which the authority behind a cited claim turns out to be that a model produced it when asked.
rule: A record cannot be re-typed to shed its derivation marking; every citation to it discloses the marking.

name: Self-Corroboration Bar
algorithm: Treat each registered engine as one source class, so repeated elicitation raises accumulated evidence without raising diversity — three assertions from one engine yield an effective source-class count of 1.0 against 3.0 for three distinct engines — and refuse a corroboration offered by a record derived from the same engine as the record it corroborates. Prevents confidence manufactured by repetition, where a hundred elicitations from one model would otherwise report near-certainty for a claim no source ever made.
rule: Effective source classes D = 1/sum of squared weight proportions; all weight in one engine yields D = 1.

name: Citation Verification of a Reply
algorithm: Verify every citation contained in a model-derived assertion against the record store, recording it as verified where it resolves and unverified where it does not; admit the assertion carrying that recording rather than withholding it, so a fabricated citation becomes a recorded property of the assertion rather than an undetected defect. Record contradictions with authored records in the contradiction index, noting the derivation difference so a reviewer knows one side originated from a model.
rule: A corroboration is admitted only where the corroborating record derives from a different source class than the record corroborated.

name: Competitive Candidate Resolution
algorithm: Where a query admits several mutually-inconsistent interpretations, activate the candidate records supporting each together rather than evaluating them in sequence; reduce each candidate's activation in proportion to the summed activation of the candidates inconsistent with it; iterate to a stable state under the existing threshold update; suppress candidates below the retention floor. The competition is among candidates rather than among domains, since a domain owns exactly one decision and two domains proposing competing answers would contradict the partition. Where two candidates survive at comparable activation the set does not resolve and clarification is requested rather than the higher being taken.
rule: Suppressed activation = a_i - k * sum of activations of candidates inconsistent with i; retained where above the floor.

name: Specialized Feed Registration
algorithm: Register a live data source with publication authority, refresh interval, staleness bound, value class, unit and dimension, restatement policy and redistribution entitlement; a registration omitting any of these is connectable but not admissible as a query source, since each governs a decision the system would otherwise make by assumption. Refuse an arithmetic combination of two values of differing dimension rather than computing it.
rule: A feed is admissible as a query source only where all seven registration properties are present.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"publication","extraction"},"publication")>0,"Admitted at publication authority; calibration bypassed","Calibrated from extraction")

name: Publication Authority Admission
algorithm: Admit a non-forecast value at its publisher's authority without applying extraction confidence, modality coefficient or source reliability, since calibration would invent an uncertainty that does not exist — a published price is not 87% likely to be the price. The record asserts that the authority published the value, not that it is correct. A forecast is admitted carrying the uncertainty its publisher states. Where a publisher states an interval, retain the interval and compute any required point by a registered rule rather than selecting one.
rule: Point value from a published interval = registered rule over the interval; the interval is retained alongside.

name: Staleness Bound
algorithm: Serve a value only where its age at query time is within the registered staleness bound; beyond it state the age and publication time rather than serving, extrapolating or substituting the nearest available. A feed value does not decay — it expires, since a quoted value does not grow less certain with age but becomes superseded, and answering from it is not answering with lower confidence but answering wrongly. Absence of publication within a multiple of the refresh interval marks the feed interrupted, distinguishing a stopped feed from an unchanged value.
rule: Serve where (query time − publication time) ≤ staleness bound; otherwise return the age and the publication time.
worked_expression: =IF(47<=60,"Within staleness bound - served","Stale - refused with age stated")

name: Restatement Distinct From Correction
algorithm: Record a publisher's revision of an already-reported period as a restatement related to the prior value, retaining the prior value unmarked and queryable as what was published at its publication time — because it was not wrong, it was correct on the information then available. Reserve the supersession chain and the erroneous marking for a revision issued as a correction. A revision arriving outside the registered restatement policy is held for a named human rather than classified by inference.
rule: A revision is a restatement or a correction by registered policy; the relation determines whether the prior value is marked erroneous.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"restatement","correction"},"restatement")>0,"Prior value retained as correct-when-published","Prior value superseded as erroneous")

name: Redistribution Entitlement
algorithm: Express what a requester may do with a served value — display, derive, delayed, or redistribute — as a dimension distinct from what they may reach. Enforce at composition rather than at export: a response that would carry a value beyond its entitlement is composed without it and the entitlement is stated, so the requester is told rather than left to infer. A derived value carries the source feed's entitlement unless a registered derivation discharges it, so an entitlement cannot be escaped by computing on a value and redistributing the result.
rule: A value enters a response only where the requester's redistribution entitlement admits the intended use.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"view","redistribute"},"redistribute")>0,"Refused - redistribution not entitled","Value may be displayed")

name: Agent Definition Completeness
algorithm: Register a defined agent only where all six phases are complete — purpose and boundary, operational function with deterministic decision rules and error handling, scope description as an entitlement, runtime with duration bound and termination condition, declared capability set, and a review with a named human approval. Refuse a definition lacking any element rather than supplying a default, since an agent whose behaviour is not fully determined before it runs cannot be evaluated before it runs. An agent without a termination condition is not registrable.
rule: Registration proceeds only where every element of all six definition phases is present.

name: Agent Capability Bounding
algorithm: Bound an agent's declared capability set above by the capabilities of the identity registering it, so an agent cannot be given authority its author does not hold; refuse an undeclared capability at the boundary at execution time. Re-perform the governance evaluation at each execution rather than at registration, so an agent does not accumulate authority by having been approved once.
rule: An operation executes only where it lies within the agent's declared capability set.

name: Agent Lifecycle Enforcement
algorithm: Enforce rather than track the lifecycle across six stages: initialization, execution within window and duration bound, non-disableable monitoring, advisory reporting, termination, archival. Terminate on lifecycle expiry, owner or operator request, governance exclusion, capability violation or exceeding a configured error rate, taking effect before the next execution. Renewal is a fresh registration with a fresh review and approval, so an agent cannot persist by inattention.
rule: An agent terminates where elapsed lifetime reaches the registered lifecycle bound, irrespective of attention.

name: Agent Decision Trace
algorithm: Write on each execution a trace of the trigger fired, scope resolved, records read, branch taken by each rule, outputs, every refusal with its cause, and compute consumed. Write it by the execution mechanism rather than by the agent, so an agent cannot omit from its own trace what it would prefer not to record, and append it to the provenance chain under the keyed-checksum discipline so later alteration is detectable. Record refusals and terminations with equal prominence to successes.
rule: A deductive conclusion an agent may admit carries confidence bounded by the least of the traversed edge confidences.

name: Advisory Distinguished From Approval
algorithm: Adopt the agent's self-analysis and warnings, which block registration on an unresolved finding, while refusing its self-confirmation of compliance: a mechanism cannot establish its own compliance, and a confirmation so produced would be relied on precisely where reliance is least warranted. Compliance is established by the governance evaluation performed upon the agent and by a named human approval. During operation an agent reports but does not decide — it does not renew itself, widen its scope, extend its lifecycle or clear its own findings.
rule: A registration or continuation proceeds on a recorded human approval; an agent's own report is advisory only.
worked_expression: =IF(COUNTIF({"advisory","approval"},"approval")>0,"Named human approval recorded","Advisory only - not an approval")
